The Dao says: When the cycles of Heaven and Earth reach an end, the stars fall into disorder, the sun and moon lose their brightness, and the four seasons lose their timing. When Yin and Yang are not harmonized, the borders of the state are restless, farmers and merchants lose their livelihoods, and epidemics spread, leading to the death and injury of the masses. If teachers or friends pass away, one should always practice the Zhai, offer incense, and recite the scripture. The merit of fasting and reciting the scripture is extremely heavy: above, it extinguishes heavenly disasters and protects the Emperor; below, it dispels poisonous harms to deliver the common people. Both the living and the dead rely on this blessing; its benefits are hard to surpass. Therefore, it is called the "Limitless Universal Salvation of Heavens and Humans."

The Dao says: Whoever possesses this scripture and performs this merit for the sake of Heaven, Earth, the Emperor, or the masses—on the day when disasters occur, if they set their heart on the Zhai, burn incense, and recite the scripture ten times, a host of auspicious signs will descend to ensure eternal Great Peace. Their names will be recorded by the various heavens, and ten thousand spirits will stand guard. To the right <note>in the celestial ranking</note>, the person of ultimate virtue will be established as a minister of the **Golden Gate** <note>The entrance to the highest celestial palace</note> for the Sage Sovereign. The heavens record human merits and faults down to the smallest hair; nothing is lost. The **True Demons** of the heavens will also protect your body. Only those who have attained the Dao can truly understand these ultimate words.

### The Chapter on the Golden Statutes of Clear Nuance

The Dao says: Long ago, in the **Heaven of the Ultimate Marvel**, the sounds of the "Cavernous Empyrean" were proclaimed, resonating through the realms of mysterious transformation. It was then that the **Limitless Upper Chapters of the Golden Statutes of Clear Nuance for the Salvation of Mankind** were received. When the **Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning** <note>Yuanshi Tianzun; the supreme deity of the Lingbao tradition</note> was about to speak this scripture, he first circled ten times to summon the deities of the ten directions. He then took his seat. 

<margin>Heaven 8</margin>

The Great Deities of the Heavenly Truth, the High Sovereigns, and the **Perfected Persons of Marvelous Conduct**, along with the nine sages of **Clear Nuance**, the Heavenly Officials of the Upper Prime, the Immortal Kings who guard the Law, and an infinite multitude of beings, all came through the air. Jade light and green radiance rose up, and clouds of three-colored vapors drifted by. Feathered canopies flowed with brilliance, and red floral essences floated in the dark void. They looked out over the Great Space. For seven days and seven nights, within the sun-drenched halls and moonlit palaces of the heavens, and through the golden gates and jade towers, the host of Perfected Ones traveled. Divine winds fanned the empyrean, producing sounds according to their rhythm. The cosmic movement ceased its usual cycles to witness the transformation into a brilliant, high clarity. Throughout the entire land, the mountains, rivers, and forests became level and equal; there was no longer high or low ground. The earth itself turned to green jade, uniform in color. 

The host of Perfected Ones attended the seating. The Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning sat suspended in the void upon a **nine-colored divine dragon**. 

When he recited the scripture **once**, all the Great Sages of the heavens simultaneously praised the goodness. At that time, the men and women of the nation each moved with sincere devotion, wishing to see the mysterious marvel. 

When he recited the scripture **twice**, the halls of the seat glowed brightly, and everyone attained a sudden, vast enlightenment. 

When he recited the scripture **three times**, the spirits all sat together in a grand assembly, observing the ten directions. 

When he recited the scripture **four times**, enlightenment was attained in the heart, and they became able to transform and guide others. 

When he recited the scripture **five times**, they reached out to lead the vast multitudes of future sentient beings. 

When he recited the scripture **six times**, they bore witness to the rank of Heavenly Immortal and practiced the Way of the Higher Truth. 

When he recited the scripture **seven times**, they transcended the three realms to become the "Seed People" of Heaven <note>the chosen survivors who transition to the next cosmic cycle</note>. 

When he recited the scripture **eight times**, they gained an audience with the Primordial Sovereign and attained spiritual rank. 

When he recited the scripture **nine times**, their names were recorded in the **Golden Statutes of Clear Nuance**. 

When he recited the scripture **ten times**, they merged their truth with the Sages and forever severed the cycle of reincarnation. At that time, every man and woman in the nation turned their hearts toward him, all receiving protection and salvation, and all attaining long life.

The Dao says: At that time, when the Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning recited the scripture **once**, the Great Spirits of the Limitless and Boundless Chapters of the **East** who grant life arrived through the air in an infinite multitude. 

When he recited **twice**, the Great Spirits of Deep Deliberation of the **South** arrived through the air in an infinite multitude.

## Wondrous Scripture of the Upper Chapters on the Limitless Salvation of Mankind of the Numinous Treasure

Within the empty void, a hundred *zhang* <note>about 1,000 feet</note> above the ground, the **Primordial One** <note>The Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning</note> ascended to reveal the **Golden Statutes**. True life was immediately established, and the High Sovereigns transformed the primordial energy. The **Perfected Persons** of the ten directions and the limitless guides, along with an uncounted multitude of Great Spirits, all entered together into the **Precious Pearl**. 

The people of the heavens looked up and saw only a swirling radiance entering through the mouth of the pearl. Once they had entered, their location could no longer be known. The people of the nation dispersed as the ground returned to a level and correct state, no longer sinking or yielding. Within that Precious Pearl, the Primordial One completed the recitation of the entire scripture. He then oversaw the salvation of beings and transmitted the text to me. At that time, the joy was beyond words. As the ritual matters were completed, the various heavens returned to their positions. In a sudden flash, all was silent, and no sound remained. At this moment, the heavenly beings who encountered this scripture and its law were all saved. All living beings bore witness to good karma; the whole land turned in devotion, and all harmonized with the void and clarity. 

There was marvelous sight and marvelous hearing, marvelous awareness and marvelous knowledge. There was marvelous existence and marvelous non-existence, marvelous union and marvelous separation. There were marvelous changes and marvelous transformations. Their words accorded with the **Ultimate Dao**, and their hearts practiced **Great Compassion**. Together they reached a dark enlightenment, pure and upright in **Non-Action** <note>Wu-wei; the Taoist principle of effortless action in harmony with the cosmos</note>. The state was secure, the people were prosperous, and all rejoiced in a time of great peace. As the scripture began its teaching, the entire nation followed the Dao. Those who possessed a sincere heart and honored it with worship were all immediately saved.

The Dao says: The words spoken by the **Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning** within the scripture are the transformed energies of the various heavens. They are the hidden names and sacred titles of the **Imperial Sovereigns and Lords of the Dao**. They are the secret chapters of the high spirits and inner names of the ten directions. They also represent the established foundations of the **Nine Layers of Earth** <note>the underworld realms</note>, the sounds of life, and the texts used to test the hundred demons. They are not ordinary words. The High Sages recorded them, and these **Golden Statutes** are kept secret within the **Heaven of Clear Nuance** <note>Qingwei; a high celestial realm</note> under strict prohibition. They are of the utmost importance; the ghostly officials are not permitted to hear them. <gloss>Volume 8</gloss> 

In the **Cavernous Mystery of Jade Vacuity**, the **Supreme Ultimate**, and the **Supreme Clarity**—across the four borders and the thirty-nine heavens—the divine immortals and Perfected Persons are able to fully understand these chapters. If one recites them ten times, the sound vibrates through the entire celestial sphere. The **Great One** <note>Taiyi; the supreme unity</note> will look down to oversee the practitioner, ensuring the safety of heaven and earth so they do not collapse even after billions of eons. 

---

The five planets will follow their proper paths, the sun and moon will always be bright, the borders will be peaceful, and great peace will be forever preserved. It can return the soul to the corpse and raise the dead, turning bleached bones back into living people. If the **Flying Immortals of Great Space** recite it ten times, the **Five Old Ones** <note>deities of the five directions</note> will recommend them for promotion, the Three Realms will bow in respect, the Great Demons will submit, and the Heavenly Officials will record their merit. The **Eight Paths** <note>The eight celestial directions</note> turn the flying wheels.
All species preserve their long years,
And the lands of the world enjoy eternal peace.

These songs are heard in the midst of the flying void above the Three Realms. These are the sounds of the songs of the perfected immortals, which participate in the "Cavern Chapters." If you recite them one hundred times, your name will be passed to the **Southern Palace** <note>Nangong; where souls are refined for immortality</note>. If you recite them one thousand times, the Demon Kings will protect and welcome you. If you recite them ten thousand times, your Way will be complete, and you will ascend to the Great Nothingness, crossing over the Three Realms to attain the rank of an Immortal Duke. 

When these true sounds are heard, the spirits and demons respect the form of the practitioner. The earth deities act as guards, following and welcoming you. You will be pulled out from the Gate of the Earth, escaping the **Five Bitternessess and Eight Hardships** <note>Various categories of suffering and spiritual obstacles</note>. Your ancestors of seven generations will be promoted. You will leave the watery ghost offices, and your soul will be saved in the **Vermilion Palace** <note>Zhu Ling; a place of spiritual purification by fire</note>, where you will undergo refinement and be reborn. This is called the "Infinite Universal Salvation." These are secret writings from the upper heavens, revered by all the heavens. If you leak them or treat them with disrespect, you will fall into hell, and the calamity will reach even your ancestors of seven generations.

The Way says: These two chapters are the secret hidden sounds of the Emperors of the various heavens and the Sovereigns of the high spirits. They are all in the **Language of the Great Brahma** <note>Dafan; a primordial celestial language, often considered more powerful than human speech</note>. They are not ordinary worldly lyrics; they have no standard rhyme and their beautiful melodies are not superficial. Their "crookedness" is called "mysterious," and their depth is difficult to explore in detail. They are kept as precious secrets in the heavens, in the Jade Purity Royal Mansion of the Divine Empyrean within the Mysterious Capital. According to the celestial regulations, they are passed down every thirty-seven thousand years when the cosmic timing is right. If there is a person of utmost virtue who offers gold and precious treasures and whose heart relies on the ancient standards, they must first swear an oath to the Jade Purity before the text is transmitted to them.

The Way says: The cycles of Heaven and Earth have their endings. The sun, moon, and five planets have their eclipses and fullnesses. Even the most sacred divine beings have their times of rest and activity. Students of the later ages also face illness and injury. Whenever these calamities occur, those of the same spiritual energy should align their hearts and practice the ritual of purification. At the six appointed hours, burn incense and recite the scripture ten times. When the three energies merge with the spirit, the ten thousand calamities will be universally dissolved. Heaven and Earth will be peaceful and serene, and the mysterious truth of the descending energy will cause the Golden Statutes and Jade Laws to subdue the ghosts and spirits. These infinite writings provide universal salvation without end.

The Way says: If a student’s practice of the Way is shallow, or if their immortal rank is not yet full, they may face "extinction and transition" <note>Death</note> when their cycle demands it. When their body passes through the **Great Yin** <note>Taiyin; the underworld or the state of death before refinement</note>, their fellow practitioners of the Way should burn incense and recite the scripture ten times for them. This is to save the form of the corpse. According to the law, the body will not decay or be harmed; the physical form will remain whole and the soul will be preserved.

# Wondrous Scripture of the Upper Chapter of the Luminous Treasure for the Infinite Salvation of Mankind, Volume 9

## The Chapter on the Jade Statutes of King Yuyu <note>Yuyu; the second of the Three Pure Heavens, often associated with the Lord of the Way</note>

The Way says: In the past, amidst the golden reflections and the turquoise Brahma-light, within the **Crimson Firmament** of the wondrous land of Great Non-Being, the **Heavenly Worthy of Primordial Beginning** <note>Yuanshi Tianzun; the highest deity in the Daoist trinity</note> received the "Infinite Upper Chapter of the Jade Statutes of Yuyu." When the Heavenly Worthy recites this scripture ten times through, he summons the Great Spirits of the True Heavens from the ten directions, the High Sovereigns and most holy ones, the Perfected Ones of Wondrous Conduct, the Nine Perfected Ones of the **Heaven of Upper Clarity** <note>Shangqing; the high celestial realm</note>, and more than ten thousand other immortals. 

An innumerable multitude of divine kings from the **Three Realms** <note>The realms of Desire, Form, and Formlessness</note> arrive through the air, riding in jeweled carriages and cloud-chariots adorned with purple smoke and green blossoms. Their spiritual radiance and feathered parasols shade the morning mists, creating ten thousand colors that shimmer and illuminate the void of the firmament. For seven days and seven nights, the sun and moon of the various heavens harmonize their light, the stars and constellations pause their rotations, and the jasper towers and jade gates all shine simultaneously. A benevolent heavenly wind blows, the Crimson Peaks are peaceful and clear, and the lands, mountains, rivers, and forests of the nation become perfectly level. There is no longer high or low ground; the soil turns to green jade, moist and lustrous, with no discordant colors.

As the various Perfected Ones sit in attendance, the Heavenly Worthy of Primordial Beginning sits suspended in the void upon a jeweled dais of nine-colored jade blossoms.

When the scripture is recited **once**, the Great Saints of the various heavens simultaneously praise its goodness. At this time, the men and women of the nation awaken and share the same carriage; they attain a wondrous energy and gain spiritual clarity.

When the scripture is recited **twice**, their ears and eyes become sharp and bright, and they realize that this Upper Clarity realm is a world of non-emptiness.

When the scripture is recited **three times**, their spirit and essence become firm and true.

When the scripture is recited **four times**, the fruits of their past karma are dissolved, and they together observe the path of **Pure Emptiness** <note>Qingxu; a state of spiritual clarity and detachment</note>.

When the scripture is recited **five times**, disasters and diseases do not arise, and the seasons become harmonious and peaceful.

When the scripture is recited **six times**, the wondrous energy circulates and transforms, and the ten thousand things all flourish.

When the scripture is recited **seven times**, the "True Wind" of governance spreads, and virtue is renewed day by day.

When the scripture is recited **eight times**, the elderly return to their youth and all attain longevity.

When the scripture is recited **nine times**, all beings everywhere receive salvation. <gloss>Heaven Nine</gloss>

They ascend to immortality. If the scripture is recited **ten times**, all the saints above and below the heavens praise it in wonder. At this time, every man and woman in the nation is covered in dark grace and looks upward with infinite devotion.

The Way says: At that time, when the Heavenly Worthy of Primordial Beginning recited the scripture **once**, an innumerable multitude of the Most True Great Spirits from the infinite eastern regions arrived, floating through the air. 
When recited **twice**, the multitude from the south arrived. 
When recited **three times**, the multitude from the west arrived. 
When recited **four times**, the multitude from the north arrived. 
When recited **five times**, the multitude from the northeast arrived. 
When recited **six times**, the multitude from the southeast arrived. 
When recited **seven times**, the multitude from the southwest arrived. 
When recited **eight times**, the multitude from the northwest arrived. 
When recited **nine times**, the multitude from the regions above arrived. 
When recited **ten times**, the multitude from the regions below arrived. <gloss>Heaven Nine</gloss> 

As the ten recitations were completed, the Great Spirits of the True Heavens from all ten directions arrived at once. The men and women of the nation turned their hearts in devotion. Those who came were like fine rain or dense mist; the heavenly beings were subtle and wondrous, their dwelling places were the essence of truth. Their transformed bodies took shape and divided into billions, and they said to one another: "We have awakened to the Way through successive eons. We are free from all dust and have attained the **Dharma-body** <note>The true, formless body of a realized being</note>. We entered the contemplation of energy and understood the Dark Emptiness."

They first dwelled in the realm of the **Great Vermilion Energy** <note>Dachi; associated with the lower of the Three Pure Heavens</note>, a domain of penetrating mystery and non-action. Then they reached **Yuyu**, advancing to the rank of Pure Truth and attaining the "Wondrous Fruit" of the ultimate Way.

"Yuyu" means vast and great; "Yu" also means far-reaching. Because its greatness is infinite, it is called **Yuyu**, the unified Primal Body that encompasses all things. "I have heard the Primordial Beginning explain the teachings and reveal the text of the **Jade Statutes of Yuyu**. This is the highest Great Law for regulating the Perfected Ones and the Immortals. It commands the many demons, dispels evil spirits, and transforms evil into good."

The innumerable multitude filled half the nation, and the earth began to sink under their weight, yet it could not be stopped. The Heavenly Worthy looked down and announced to the assembly: "You who have studied the Way and ascended to the rank of the True, you hold positions in **Upper Clarity** and dwell in **Yuyu**. Your legal nature is natural and spontaneous; you are already beyond change. Your coarse habits are purified, and subtle attachments do not arise. Since you have no faults, why would you need the 'True Statutes'?"

"However, if one establishes a religion to pass down instructions to humanity but does not establish codes and statutes to manage cultivation, it would be like the Celestial Emperors or Immortals who have surpassed the nine ranks of the earth and dissolved all legal ties, yet still wear round crowns and square shoes, carry swords and jade tablets, and ride in feathered carriages with dragon and phoenix banners. These are the markers of the Law. How can they not be discussed? Now, I bring forth the mystery of the Jade Statutes of Yuyu, the text that regulates Heaven, Earth, and the Spirits. If one honors it in their own person, the shadow of grace reaches <gloss>one or two</gloss> ten thousand ancestors. If one practices it for <gloss>one or three</gloss> thousand days, blessings will flow to the ten directions. You must <gloss>one or four</gloss> listen with reverence and not be negligent." This is the text of the spirits. <gloss>Heaven Nine</gloss>

Thereupon, the Primordial Beginning suspended a **Jeweled Pearl** <note>Baozhu; a symbol of the concentrated essence of the universe</note> the size of a grain of rice in the middle of the empty void, fifty feet above the ground. The Primordial Beginning then led the Great Spirits of the True Heavens, the High Sovereigns, the Perfected Ones of Wondrous Conduct, and the innumerable multitude of the Most True Great Spirits from the ten directions to **enter into the Jeweled Pearl**. The people of the nation looked up and saw them flickering like shadows as they entered the mouth of the pearl. Once they had entered, their location was unknown. The people of the nation dispersed, and the land became vast and level.

# The Daoist Canon

The land became perfectly level once more, without any tilting or depressions. Within the **Jeweled Pearl**, the **Primordial Beginning** <note>Yuanshi Tianzun; the highest Daoist deity</note> finished reciting the scripture. 

The various Perfected Ones oversaw the salvation of beings and transmitted the teachings to me. At that moment, the joy was beyond words. The ritual matters were roughly completed, and the various heavens returned to their positions. In an instant, it was quiet, and no lingering sound remained. At this time, the heavenly beings who encountered this scripture and its laws all attained universal salvation and fulfilled their natural lifespans without any premature harm. The entire land looked up in devotion, and all practiced the truth of the Way. They were selfless and without evil, without leaks or stains, without attachments or desires, without filth or greed, and without anger. Their words were never false or boastful; their mouths chanted virtuous sounds. They shared a common compassion and love, treated distant relatives as kin, the country became peaceful, the people grew prosperous, and all rejoiced in great peace. When the scripture first appeared, it taught the whole nation the Way; those who had the will to honor and respect it all attained transcendence from the world.

The Way says: The words spoken by the Heavenly Worthy of Primordial Beginning in this scripture are the **Internal Names and Hidden Rhythmic Sounds** <note>Divine syllables believed to hold the primordial power of creation</note> of the Great Sovereigns of the various heavens. They are also the "Jade Statutes of Yuyu," the internal secret names of the True Kings and the secret names of the hundred spirits. Those who know this Way reach the Truth through the Law, and through the Truth, they meet the Way. In this subtle and wondrous state, the spirit is forgotten in the void, and the Way is maintained in nothingness. If one provides offerings and honors them with respect, their household will flourish and their lineage will prosper for generations. Through this good karmic connection, ten thousand disasters will not interfere, and divine beings will guard their gate. This scripture is supremely wondrous and stands alone in the **Jade Capital** <note>Yujing; the celestial city of the highest deities</note>. It saves an infinite number of people and is the ancestor of the ten thousand Ways. Its great model is majestic, and its virtue is beyond measure.

### Supreme Wondrous Scripture of the Primordial Infinite Salvation

The Primordial Grotto-Mystery Numinous Treasure Original Chapter, the <gloss>Top of the Five Registers</gloss> Law of the Supreme Emperor for Saving Humanity. The Hidden Rhythmic Sounds of the Perfected Ones, the soaring energy of the Great Void <gloss>Heaven 9</gloss>, the Jade Void of the Three Primes. At the start of the **Dragon-Aeon** <note>Longhan; the first of the great cosmic cycles of time</note>, the gathered energies flourished, and the flying spirits sparkled. They govern the ten thousand heavens, the immortals, and the numinous perfected ones, distinguishing good from evil and restraining demonic energy so it may not run wild or destroy the correct order. ### The Incantation for Dispelling Calamities

Calamities are already present; there are ten paths of calamity. They throw the heavenly constants into chaos and bring punishment.
The rivers and currents are stern and harsh; subtle misfortunes strike the rural cities. Floating banners and the taking of trophies;
The Wind-Knives <note>A Daoist hell-punishment involving slicing winds</note> tear and split. In Luo Feng <note>The capital of the underworld</note>, forms are extinguished. The **Old Man of the Nine Glooms** <note>A high-ranking deity of the underworld</note> dons a brocade scarf.
Misfortunes like the shamanic winds arrive; the autumn gales blow suddenly. In the morning, one rides the Golden Horse to ascend the Jade Capital.
The covenant-body is like the Lian-yu <note>A mythical beast, here likely referring to a state of being</note>; decapitate the ghosts and spirits. In the court of blessings, the Jue-Emperor examines the souls.
Command the Five Emperors to ride the gale and recite; the shaking vessel returns the flow through dangerous smoke.
The boiling cauldrons and fire-chambers fly with evil smoke; the body of the swallow arrives in a flash of light.
Ten thousand armored soldiers guard the Winding Springs <note>The underworld</note>; the Primal Source follows the punishment for sins, crying out to Heaven.
Rebellious ministers and unfilial sons cause harm to these words.

### The Prayer for Ancestral Salvation

May we obtain the palace pavilions and the darkened roof-tiles; do not violate the Jade Law, or you shall fall headlong.
And die in the yin-winds; the weather is damp and soaking. Ten thousand spirits uphold the Law and receive the departing text.
The stubborn and the surging can prosper; the head of compassion is broad. Justice, loyalty, and filial piety are the Gates of the Dao.
The shamanic energy should be long-lasting; guarding the empty mountains. Why bring sorrow upon oneself in the fields of the dead?
May the Lian-yu be incorruptible without interval; the cultivation of breath follows the vow of the Immortals.
The Spontaneous Emperor of Heaven bestows upon you the Green Incense of the Net of Non-existence, the chaotic mystery.
The **Seven Generations of Ancestors** <note>The practitioner's direct lineage</note> are liberated and ascend to the Great Mystery; all the banners leap for joy.
Let the people have long life and joy, in Great Peace; the canopy is solemn, here in **Upper Clarity**.
Pass through the stern Master of Fate; he records your name. Practice according to the Law and have an audience with the Emperor.

---

Listen to the embankment of karma, the surging silt of Xiao;
Enter the scenery, floating on a carriage, born in the Purple Chamber.
The morning light awakens the infant, seated in the carriage of celebration.

### The Great Law of the Jade Morning

The Great Law of the Jade Morning of the Three Heavens <gloss>Nine</gloss> is the Wondrous Text of the Three Vapors <gloss>Twelve</gloss>, the cavern-union of the transformed Primal Pure Heaven.
It is called the **Great Crimson Primal** <note>Taiqing/Grand Clarity</note>; it is the **Upper Clarity Heaven** <note>Shangqing</note> called **Yu Yu**; it is the **Jade Clarity Heaven** <note>Yuqing</note> called **Pure Tenuity**. Before the Three Vapors were divided, the primordial chaos was one. When the Three Sceneries <note>Sun, Moon, and Stars</note> opened their light, the Three Vapors then divided. In the age of Red Splendor, the Jade Law was the hidden truth. The Primal Vapor was fine and subtle, interlacing to form the text. That vapor lay hidden, becoming the Jade Essence. 

Across billions of eons within the chaos, the Upper Mystery was lush and cloudy, while the Lower Primal was scattered and divided. The wondrous vapor was majestic, and the Jade Light condensed the essence. The **Emperor of the Primordial Beginning** (Yuanshi) appeared, manifesting first as the **Divine Infant**. The vapor of the wind and the mystery of the water used the Cavernous Void as their body. The golden radiance shone upon the Heavenly Flowers. Once the Beginning of the Dao was manifested, it opened a transformation that is infinite, spanning ten thousand realms.

The ten thousand ways are governed by this; the regulations and codes flow forth. The movement and degree of nature are the warp and woof of the masses. Boundless billions of profound officials turn and inspect the refined truth. Its preservation through the eon-cycles ensures that the life-force (qi) exists forever. The Primal Incense entwines the Thirty-Two Heavens. The wheel of the Numinous Virtue turns to save the ten directions. Above, it opens the Imperial Abodes; below, it passes through the Cavern Palaces. It proclaims the hidden chapters and the nine grades of talismans. Chanting and singing to harmonize the vapors, the spiritual wind gathers the smoke. The Purple Void is lush and elegant, supporting ten thousand immortals.

The thousand harmonies and ten thousand unions naturally become true. Within there are gods: the **Great Lord of Long Life**, the **Prince of No-Shadow** (Wuying), the **Venerable Deity of White Primality**, the Lords of the Four Extremities, and the Imperial Sovereigns of the Primal Emperor, the forbidden and honored ones.

# I. The Sound of the Flying Void of Clear Tenuity, the Jade Law of Yu-yu

> Congregated outside the Three Realms, the Great Qi congeals into the Cinnabar Mystery. Between the King’s Pavilion and the Flowery Buds,

This is the song of the True Kings in the flying void above the Three Realms; its sounds reach the Chapters of the Cavern.

This text is of the utmost gravity in the celestial prohibitions. It is not composed of common worldly phrases; its words have no rhythmic beauty and its melodies are not flowery.
Thus, it is called "Mystic and Profound," difficult to investigate or detail. It is a treasure of the upper heavens, kept secret in the Jade Clarity Royal Palace of the Divine Empyrean.

The Dao says: The Jade Law of Yu-yu monitors the ten thousand Perfected ones, determining their merits and errors, and overseeing the hundred gods.
When the cycles of Heaven and Earth meet with obstruction or end, or when the Sun, Moon, and Five Stars wax and wane, the Great Sages and Divine Men experience these shifts.
As for the unlearned men who suffer from illness or injury, all such calamities are governed by the officials of the Heavenly Bureau who keep the records.

The Law will not pardon them. Those of the same vapor should all cultivate with a single heart, performing incense rites during the six periods of the day, and turning the scripture ten times.
When a Daoist Master ascends the altar, they must be solemn and orderly, reciting this Great Scripture of the Jade Law according to the ritual. Blessings and merit will immediately descend, and all inauspiciousness will be dispelled. This is the text of infinite and

# The Supreme Wondrous Scripture of Infinite Salvation of Numinous Treasure, Volume 10
## The Chapter on the Numinous Scripts of Great Crimson

The Dao says: Long ago in the **Purple Dawn Heaven** <note>Zichen Tian, a high celestial realm associated with the primordial dawn</note>, gold and jade flew through the air in the Great Bright Land of Jewels. I received the **Numinous Scripts of Great Crimson** <note>Dachi Lingwen, sacred texts associated with the second of the Three Clarities, often linked to the refinement of spirit</note> of the Infinite Upper Chapters. When the **Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning** <note>Yuanshi Tianzun, the highest deity in the Daoist pantheon</note> was about to speak this scripture, he orbited ten times to summon the ten directions. He first questioned the assembly. Then, the Great Divine Beings of Celestial Perfection, the High Saints and Elevated Sovereigns, the Perfected Ones of Wondrous Conduct, the **True King of Supreme Clarity** <note>Taiqing Zhenwang</note>, the Saints of the Seven Heavens, the Kings of the **Great Ultimate** <note>Taiji</note>, the officials of the left and right bureaus, the Numinous Youths and Jade Maidens—an infinite multitude—came riding through the air.

Their cloud-carriages and flying chariots, their ornate palanquins and precious wheels, their cinnabar canopies casting shadows, and the radiance of the **Jade Flowers** <note>Yuhua, a symbol of celestial purity</note> scattered brilliance. Five colors flowed and dazzled, illuminating the Great Void. For five days and five nights, the realms of the various heavens, the deep carriages of the Dark Brilliance, the spirit-nets and resting wheels, the Jade Standards and Golden Stars, all stopped their movement at once. The celestial winds became silent, and the gathering clouds in the empyrean solidified. The waves were extinguished and became still within **Heaven and Earth** <note>original: "Qiankun"</note>. The entire nation became transparently clear. The lands, mountains, and forests became flat and uniform, with no distinction between high and low. The soil was entirely bright and translucent, shimmering with the essence of emerald, without any discordant colors.

The host of Perfected Ones stood in attendance. The Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning sat in profound meditation, floating in the void upon a five-colored, glowing **Jade Lotus**.

As he recited the scripture for the **first time**, the Great Saints of the various heavens simultaneously praised its goodness. At that time, the men and women of the entire nation awakened their hearts to the Great Void and attained the Dao of Non-Action.

As he recited the scripture a **second time**, they perceived the **Dharma-body** <note>The true, formless essence of a divine being</note> and were forever freed from the dust of worldly leakage.

As he recited the scripture a **third time**, their hearts transcended the Wondrous Origin and they understood all phenomena.

As he recited the scripture a **fourth time**, their spiritual wisdom became complete, and they were able to fly freely.

As he recited the scripture a **fifth time**, their explanations of the meanings flowed like water, and they spread the Ultimate Dao.

As he recited the scripture a **sixth time**, they reflected light back upon their **Original Spirit** <note>Taiguang, the "embryonic light" or first of the three souls</note> and attained infinite stillness.

As he recited the scripture a **seventh time**, the **Jade Gate** <note>a physical/spiritual pass within the body</note> harmonized the vapors, and liquid pearls flowed through the Spirit Palace.

As he recited the scripture an **eighth time**, the shadows turned within the **Qian-Forest** <note>A celestial forest in the highest heavens</note>, and they obtained the longevity of the various heavens.

As he recited the scripture a **nine time**, the ten thousand things flourished, and none suffered premature death.

As he recited the scripture a **tenth time**, celestial music floated in the void, and cloud encampments gathered auspicious omens. At this time, every man and woman in the nation turned their hearts toward him; all received protection and salvation, and all attained long life.

The Dao says: At that time, when the Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning recited the scripture for the first time, the Great Divine Beings of Ultimate Truth and the infinite multitudes of the **Eastern** Infinite Realm arrived, floating through the void.

When he recited it a second time, the multitudes of the **Southern** Infinite Realm arrived.
When he recited it a third time, the multitudes of the **Western** Infinite Realm arrived.
When he recited it a fourth time, the multitudes of the **Northern** Infinite Realm arrived.
When he recited it a fifth time, the multitudes of the **Northeastern** Infinite Realm arrived.
When he recited it a sixth time, the multitudes of the **Southeastern** Infinite Realm arrived.
When he recited it a seventh time, the multitudes of the **Southwestern** Infinite Realm arrived.
When he recited it an eighth time, the multitudes of the **Northwestern** Infinite Realm arrived.
When he recited it a ninth time, the multitudes of the **Upper** Infinite Realm arrived.
When he recited it a tenth time, the multitudes of the **Lower** Infinite Realm arrived.

When the ten recitations were completed, the Great Divine Beings of the Infinite Heavens from all ten directions and ten realms arrived simultaneously. The men and women of the nation looked up with devotion. Those who came were like drifting clouds and gathering rain. The infinite multitude each bowed their heads in greeting at the Jade Steps and said: "In the place where your subjects reside..."

## Register 1

Heaven exists above the **Seed People** <note>Zhongmin, the righteous survivors of cosmic cycles chosen to repopulate the new world</note> within the void of **Supreme Clarity** and **Great Crimson** <note>Taiqing and Dachi, terms for the third of the three highest heavens in Daoist cosmology</note>. Within this heaven, the ten thousand phenomena appear instantly upon a thought and vanish as soon as thoughts cease. In this vast, boundless, and brilliant void—the realm of the Dao—the nine breaths of the sacred ranks have already ascended, shedding all worldly entanglements. All empty imaginings, whether belonging to "existence" or "non-existence," are gone. To realize this is to achieve eternal life.

The **Great Crimson Heaven** is the foremost of the three Great Void Mystery Realms. It is illuminated by the colors of the **Three Flowers** <note>Sanhua, representing the refinement of essence, breath, and spirit</note>. Below, it is anchored by the flying wheels that guard the Celestial Pass.

We respectfully hear that the Celestial Worthy, within this sacred realm of the **Great Ultimate** <note>Taiji</note>, has revealed the **Numinous Scripts**. He has manifested them clearly within the dark empyrean so that all sentient beings below, throughout the infinite worlds of the Divine Continent, may together attain the supreme fruit and receive infinite blessings. We, your subjects, each direct our will toward the Dao to listen to these ultimate words.

Thereupon, the **Primordial Beginning** <note>Yuanshi Tianzun</note> suspended a single **Precious Pearl**, no larger than a grain of millet, in the center of the empty void, five hundred feet above the ground. Once inside, their location could no longer be perceived from the outside. The land of the nation became expansive, distant, and level, with no further demonic cries or dangerous terrain. Within this **Precious Pearl** <gloss>beneath the heavens</gloss>, the recitation of the scripture was completed. The host of Perfected Ones then descended to bestow it upon me. At that time, the joy was beyond words; the ritual matters were fully understood, the various heavens returned to their positions, and in an instant, all was silent without a lingering sound. At this moment, the celestial beings who encountered this scripture were all saved, preserving their original lifespan without injury. The entire land turned in devotion, all attaining the state of the **Dark Void**—without thought, without desire, without form, without sound, without killing, without blemish, and without falsehood.

# Supreme Wondrous Scripture of Infinite Salvation of the Primordial Beginning
## Before the throne of the Supreme Sovereign of the Thirty-Two Heavens, draw in the breath thirty-two times, face East, and recite the scripture.

The **Numinous Treasure of the Primordial Mystery**—the core chapter of the Numinous Scripts of Great Crimson, the Supreme Chapter of Mystery and Emptiness for Infinite Salvation. These are the hidden rhythms of the **Highest Clarity** <note>Taiqing</note>, the natural union and separation of the primordial jade text. In the age of the Sovereign of True Stillness and Mysterious Communication, the Sacred Treasure was born. The Numinous Script saves lives, providing shade and protection beneath the Mysterious Void and Supreme Clarity. The Three Palaces are arranged in rows, merging with the Dao. The Great Person of the Primordial Chaos stands within the vast eon, establishing the various heavens. In the **Court of Great Crimson**, the Perfected Ones and Jade Assistants of the High Mystery transform into immortals, governing the nine ranks below. They open the celestial offices; their lives have no limit of years, and even at the end of an eon, they do not perish.

They nourish the azure void and look down upon the distant realms. Across the twelve regions, the Eight Scenes are clear and high. The Three Paths are celebrated as the Numinous Script transforms. Upon a thought, it manifests itself; the Great Image is revealed. <gloss>Heaven 10</gloss> This is the Central Heaven of the Mysterious Brahma, the Three Sovereigns of the Numinous Divinity, the Great Ultimate of Hidden Truth. ## Chapter on the Revolving Salvation of Jade Brightness

**The Way says:** Long ago, within the **Heaven of Emptiness and Jade-Green**, upon the **Great Treasure Cliff of the Jade Firmament’s Radiant Scenery**, I received from the Primordial Beginning the **Highest Rank of the Infinite Revolving Salvation of Jade Brightness**. When the **Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning** <note>The supreme deity and personification of the Dao</note> was about to speak this scripture, it was recited in ten full cycles to summon the Great Spirits of the Ten Directions. At the start, as the seats were requested, a countless multitude of Great Divine Beings of the Heavenly Truth, High Sovereigns of the Upper Sanctity, and **True Persons of Subtle Action** <note>highly evolved spiritual beings</note> arrived through the void. Purple clouds radiated brilliance, crimson flowers spread their colors, and phoenixes and dragons pulled the carriages. With rainbow-colored wheels shading the scene and containing the crystalline essence, five-colored lights pierced and illuminated the Great Vacuity. For nine days and nine nights, the sun, moon, and stars of the various heavens stayed their course to honor the precious light; the mechanisms of fate paused, the Jade Pivot <note>the celestial axis</note> congealed its light, the Golden Balance ceased its movement, and the divine winds fell into a peaceful silence. As the clouds withdrew from the seas and peaks, the **Six Breaths** <note>the environmental energies of the seasons</note> became harmonious and clear. Throughout the land, the mountains, rivers, forests, and trees all became level and uniform, with no further distinction between high and low. Above, the Jade-Green was perfected, and the jade itself was of a singular, pure color. 

As the multitude of Perfected Beings took their seats, the Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning sat calmly upon a treasure throne floating in the void—a throne of the **Nine-fold True Phoenix Energy of Gold**. 

When the scripture was recited **once**, the Great Saints of the various heavens simultaneously praised its goodness. At that time, the men and women of the nation enjoyed long lives, free from disaster or premature death. 
When the scripture was recited **twice**, the waters rose and the fires descended <note>an alchemical metaphor for internal balance</note>, and no harm or punishment arose. 
When the scripture was recited **three times**, the Six Breaths were harmonized and the entire world became tranquil. 
When the scripture was recited **four times**, a subtle fragrance flew from the heavens, weaving through the air to form floating canopies. 
When the scripture was recited **five times**, the mountains and marshes presented auspicious omens, and jade discs and pearls appeared. 
When the scripture was recited **six times**, beings awakened to the root of life and death, and their spirits bore witness to the Realm of Truth. 
When the scripture was recited **seven times**, the people of the **Desire Realm** <note>Kamadhatu, the realm of sensory attachment</note> were entirely cleansed of their worldly toil. 
When the scripture was recited **eight times**, the Five Cycles <note>the movements of the five elements</note> were harmonized, and all things flourished. 
When the scripture was recited **nine times**, heavenly light was bestowed downward, and the dark offices <note>the underworld/purgatory</note> were opened and illuminated.

**The Way says:** At that time, when the Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning recited the scripture **once**, a countless multitude of the Great Spirits of Perfect Truth of the Infinite Jade-Brightness Revolving Salvation from the **Eastern Direction** arrived, floating through the void.

From afar, the **Primordial Beginning** was seen ascending the throne to preach the Law, radiating a great brilliance that illuminated immeasurable heavenly worlds. The men and women of the nation and the various heavenly beings—infinite in number—each resided in their own heaven and dwelt in their own realm of transformation. Each listened with divine attention, reverently hearing the **Jade Voice** of the Celestial Worthy resound as he proclaimed the subtle and wondrous Law of the **Jade Brightness Revolving Salvation**.

They spoke to one another, discussing the teachings: "The Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning now speaks the Law of Jade Brightness Revolving Salvation and the calculated numbers of the great and small kalpas <note>An eon or vast cycle of cosmic time</note>. I know that the root of life and death for all heavenly beings depends entirely on this 'revolving salvation.' The numbers of these cycles are rooted in Yin and Yang. The energies of Yin and Yang are themselves life and death: Yang energy is life, while Yin energy is death. Since we turn according to Yin and Yang, this living form is bound by the numbers of life, death, and revolving salvation. If one can attain the Dao and ascend into the **Formless**, transcending Yin and Yang, then there is no more life and death, nor any bondage to the numbers of the great or small cosmic cycles."

The assembled multitude, each focusing their hearts, gathered together toward the **Heaven of the Great Treasure of Empty Jade-Green** to request to hear the essential Jade Brightness Revolving Salvation—to learn how to practice so as to escape Yin and Yang, avoid life and death, realize a "Body of Wondrous Existence," become a Great Dharma King, and deliver all sentient beings from the sea of the great kalpa. Those who came were like fine rain or dense mist; such was the infinite crowd that half the land of the nation was tilted or weighed down by them, and they could not be restrained.

Thereupon, the Primordial Beginning suspended a single **Solid Pearl**, <gloss>31</gloss> as small as a grain of millet, in the midst of the Empty Mystery, hanging five rods above the ground. The Primordial Beginning then led the great divine beings of the Heavenly Truth, the High Sovereigns of the Upper Sanctity, and the **True Persons of Subtle Action**, along with the infinite multitude, to enter all together into the Treasure Pearl. The heavenly beings looked up and saw only a blurring motion as the crowd entered through the mouth of the pearl. Once they had entered the pearl’s mouth, their location could not be known. The Primordial Beginning then manifested a divine transformation: the inside of the pearl became vast and expansive, containing the heavens of the ten directions and all the lands of the world. From amidst the multitude, he radiated a purple-

-gold light that shimmered in seven colors. From within these colors emerged clouds of exquisite fragrance that filled the interior of the pearl. He turned his blue-lotus eyes and looked down upon the multitude. He alone bore the universal virtue of the **Treasured Carven Dragon and Auspicious Jade**. With a harmonious and joyful expression, he spoke to the multitude, saying: 

"Jade Brightness is the name of Heaven's talent. It refers to the fact that these myriad heavens each undergo revolving salvation. This revolving never rests, and thus life and death never stop. All heavenly beings are exhausted by 'purposeful action' <note>actions driven by desire or attachment</note> and the toil of rest and labor. Following the cycles, they abandon the Way and Virtue to enter the flow of life and death. This is all because the hearts of sentient beings possess grasping and rejecting, severed wisdom and various biased views, greed, desire, joy, and anger. They enter the 'wooden collar' <note>a pillory or shackle</note> of Yin and Yang. As the cycles change, they experience ten thousand births and ten thousand deaths, never creating the Formless and never recognizing the Body of the Way."

"I now proclaim the essentials of the Law: the **Luminous Revolving Salvation**. 'Revolving' refers to the numerical cycles of Heaven and Earth. The alternation of Yin and Yang is the root of Heaven and Earth, and the root of life and death. Since energy has a beginning and an end, there are numerical cycles of salvation. In the numbers of Heaven, every thirty years brings a 'small change,' every hundred years a 'middle change,' and every five hundred years a 'great change.' Three great changes constitute one *Record*. Three *Records* constitute a 'Great Preparation'—a span of six thousand years.

The Map of Heaven has twelve 'Net-ropes,' and the Record of Earth has twelve 'Stations.' The Net-ropes of Heaven revolve for 360 days to complete one circuit. The Record of Earth shifts every 3,300 days <gloss>91</gloss> to move the mechanism one degree. When the Heavenly Cycle completes 30,600 circuits, it is called **Yang Movement**. In 300 years, the Earthly Mechanism shifts 3,300 degrees; this is called **Yin Erosion**, spanning 30,000 years. At 9,900 degrees, the energies of Heaven and Earth intersect; this lasts 90,000 years and is named the **Great Yang Nine**. The **Great Hundred-Six** <note>traditional terms for catastrophic cosmic cycles</note> is the revolving salvation of the Great Kalpa. The Small Yang Nine and Small Hundred-Six follow the same pattern for the Small Kalpa."

"At the time of the Great Revolving Salvation, when the Heavenly Qi is exhausted by Greater Yin, it becomes a great [fire], and when the Earthly Qi reaches its peak in Greater Yang, it becomes water. When these two energies collide, the ten thousand things are dissolved and digested.

Afterward, the Original Energy (Yuanqi) recombines and returns once more to **Primordial Chaos**. This is what is meant by the revolving salvation of the Kalpa-numbers. Because they were produced by the two energies of Yin and Yang, they must perish along with those energies. 

However, above the Three Realms, in the **Heavens of the Four Peoples** and in my own capital, the **City of Grand Clarity** (Daluo) in the Three Purities, there exists a realm of ultimate encounter where water and fire cannot reach and the numbers of disaster do not arrive. This realm exists outside the two energies of Yin and Yang, life and death. Nine 'Great Revolutions' make one Kalpa. 810,000 years make a Great Revolving Salvation. 90,000 years make a Small Kalpa and a Small Revolving Salvation. 

When the Great Revolving Salvation reaches its end, the Golden Scripts and Jade Characters, the **Dragon Strophes and Phoenix Script**, and all the scriptures I have distributed all return to the Jade Capital of Grand Clarity. When the Primordial Chaos is re-divided, the True Scripts emerge once more, and the Sages circulate them, passing them down again to the lower world. 

Any sentient being who can tire of life and death, sever all taints and worldly habits, and allow their spirit and energy to merge wondrously with the **Great Void**—the substance of the Void is natural and does not belong to Yin and Yang—will naturally be free from life and death. By tallying with this Wondrous Emptiness, they can manifest form according to their thoughts, ascend into the Formless, and when the cycles of salvation are finished, they will fly up to Grand Clarity. They exit the Three Realms, eternally leaving life and death, and attain the rank of the Way. Only then, by being recorded among the <gloss>32</gloss> <gloss>31</gloss> Heavenly Truths, are they said to have 'Attained the Dao.'"

"All those beings who, because they are still learning the Way, dwell in the **Lesser Vehicle**, may have their lifespans limited by the kalpas. Though they may fly back and forth, divide their forms, scatter their shadows, or ride upon dragons and phoenixes, these are all attachments and cannot yet be called the 'extinction of leaks' <note>freedom from all karmic outflows/desires</note>."

As the multitude heard these words, they all emerged from the **Three Emptinesses** and bore witness to the Supreme True Way. The people of the nation dispersed, and the land returned to being level and upright, no longer tilted or sunken. 

The Primordial Beginning finished speaking the scripture within the Solid Pearl. The various Perfected Beings oversaw the salvation and passed the teachings to me. At that time, the joy was beyond words. The ritual matters were concluded in brief, and the various heavens...

They govern the flow of the Three Luminaries <note>the sun, moon, and stars</note> and the Five Planets, including the degrees of their concealment, staying, and retrograde movements. The celestial movements and stellar degrees are used to record the sequence of the "Great and Small" cycles of disaster <note>original: *Yang-jiu* and *Bai-liu*, referring to specific numerological periods of cosmic catastrophe</note>. The "Small Limit" consists of 365 days; the "Great Limit" consists of 810,000 or 9,990,000,000 measures of Qi. The celestial officials use tallies to calculate these movements, observing the Qi and examining the calendars to know the timing of the King of Brightness.
>
> When these cycles conclude, they end in Yin and Yang. Yin and Yang are rooted in life and death; the cycle of life and death is driven by Yin and Yang. For those who know these sounds and can turn and recite them, the various heavens will dispatch the "True Officials of the Cycles" to descend and observe their person. They record the practitioner's diligent merit and report it to the high heavens. The ten thousand spirits will then bow in salute, the Earth Spirits will stand guard at the gate, and the Great True King will recommend the practitioner to the **Highest Purity** <note>original: *Shangqing*, one of the highest heavens</note>. Having achieved the Way, they will be able to travel through the Three Realms and ascend through the Golden Gates.

Heaven is free of murky filth, and the Earth is free of demonic dust. This is the "Dark Mystery" of great capacity, where dark wisdom pierces through to clarity.

# Wondrous Scripture of the Upper Chapters of the Infinite Salvation of Mankind from the Primordial Beginning, Volume 12
## The Chapter on the Transformation and Birth of Yin and Yang

The Way says: Formerly, in the Heaven of Grand Simplicity and Imperial Ultimate <note>original: *Taisu Huangji Tian*, the highest state of primordial matter</note>, within the Land of Great Goodness and Brightness where purple subtlety flows with light, the **Primordial Celestial Worthy** <note>the supreme deity representing the beginning of the universe</note> received the Infinite Upper Chapters of the Transformation and Birth of Yin and Yang for the salvation of mankind.

As the Celestial Worthy began to speak this scripture, he traveled through ten cycles of recitation to summon the ten directions. At the start, the Great Deities of Heavenly Truth, the High Sovereigns and Sacred Elders, the Perfected Ones of Wondrous Conduct, and a countless multitude of beings arrived through the air. Jade-green clouds condensed their radiance, and purple gold reflected the light. Jasper flowers gathered from the four directions, and the "Heavens’ Flute" <note>natural music of the spheres</note> created divine melodies. They arrived in vermilion-jade carriages and golden-flower palanquins, shaded by iridescent clouds that displayed the three primary colors. The white wheels of their chariots were attended by Nine Truths, who observed a fast for seven days and seven nights. The Five Planets <note>original: *Wu-wei*, the "Five Latitudes"</note> shone with clear brightness, and auspicious mists rose into the sky. The thickets and forests became elegant and lush. The entire land, its mountains, rivers, and trees, became perfectly level without high or low ground. The soil became sweet and moist, and the springs of immortality attended the assembly.

The Primordial Celestial Worthy sat suspended in the void upon a throne of five-colored lions. He recorded the scripture:

*   **Upon the first recitation:** The Great Sages of the various heavens simultaneously praised the goodness of the teaching. At that time, the men and women of the nation achieved a clear awakening of the mechanism of life, no longer fearing for their lifespan.
*   **Upon the second recitation:** Yin and Yang merged their virtues, and the "Dark Body" <note>the spiritual essence</note> ascended in harmony.
*   **Upon the third recitation:** Flying immortals trod through the void, and spiritual beings distributed the sacred tallies.
*   **Upon the fourth recitation:** Divine dragons moved with vigor, and dark evils were entirely eliminated.
*   **Upon the fifth recitation:** The "Green Chambers" <note>meditation rooms or inner organs</note> produced divine smoke, and the "Spirit Windows" <note>the eyes or spiritual perception</note> were illuminated through and through.
*   **Upon the sixth recitation:** The buds of life burst forth, and the virtue of Yang surged with auspiciousness.
*   **Upon the seventh recitation:** The Path of Life was universally solidified, and all forms were perfected.
*   **Upon the eighth recitation:** Spiritual light cast its protective shade, and all images received grace.
*   **Upon the ninth recitation:** The various heavens descended to the earth, and all categories of life were generated and completed.
*   **Upon the tenth recitation:** The multitude of Perfected Ones oversaw the covenant, and the Great Law was fully revealed.

---

At that time, every man and woman in the nation turned their hearts toward the teaching. All received protection and salvation, and all attained long life.

The Way says: At that time, when the Primordial Celestial Worthy spoke the scripture:

*   **With the first recitation:** From the Eastern Infinite Realm, the Great Deity of Original Transformation arrived with a countless multitude, floating through the air.
*   **With the second recitation:** From the Southern Infinite Realm, the Red Crystal Great Deity arrived with a countless multitude.
*   **With the third recitation:** From the Western Infinite Realm, the Great Deity of White Majesty arrived with a countless multitude.
*   **With the fourth recitation:** From the Northern Infinite Realm, the Great Deity of Lurking Subtlety arrived with a countless multitude.
*   **With the fifth recitation:** From the Northeastern Infinite Realm, the Great Deity of the Suppressing Ultimate arrived with a countless multitude.
*   **With the sixth recitation:** From the Southeastern Infinite Realm, the Great Deity of the Wind-Wheel arrived with a countless multitude.
*   **With the seventh recitation:** From the Southwestern Infinite Realm, the Great Deity of the Highest Empyrean arrived with a countless multitude.
*   **With the eighth recitation:** From the Northwestern Infinite Realm, the Great Deity of Vast Movement arrived with a countless multitude.
*   **With the ninth recitation:** From the Higher Infinite Realm, the Great Deity of High Mystery arrived with a countless multitude.
*   **With the tenth recitation:** From the Lower Infinite Realm, the Great Deity of Maintaining Completion arrived with a countless multitude.

As the ten recitations concluded, the Great Deities of the Heavenly Truth from all ten directions arrived at once. The men and women of the nation leaned their hearts toward them in devotion, grasping the "Real Power." Flower-canopies fluttered down, and spiritual parrots rode upon the wind. Hundreds of millions gathered, looking up at the Celestial Worthy as he expounded the subtle Great Law of the Transformation and Birth of Yin and Yang. The countless multitude was so vast they could not be contained in one country. The earth brought forth gold, jade, and the "Dew of Grace."

---

The teaching spread through the void. Then, the Primordial Celestial Worthy emitted the light of the sun and moon from between his eyebrows. It had nine rays and ten blossoms, and was as large as a crossbow pellet. It hovered nine feet from his face, leaping up and down and scattering rays of light. In a moment, it filled the heavens and the earth. The worlds of the ten directions became a single, unified color. The celestial beings and sacred multitudes gazed at it without blinking. The light of the sun and moon intertwined and transformed into a **single pearl** <note>original: *shen-zhu*, a divine or miraculous orb</note>. Its primordial color was extraordinary, and all who saw it were filled with wonder.

Within this pearl, there appeared Great Characters of Celestial Script, True Diagrams of Jade Books, Treasure Chapters of Dragon and Phoenix patterns, and the forms of Tortoises and Snakes—all spread out in a vast expanse. Furthermore, within the light of the pearl, one could see layered pavilions and high towers, phoenix platforms many fathoms high, and forests of orchids and precious gems. The colors were fused and beautiful in the void. Standing in this realm, the immortals were suspended hundreds of feet high.

The Primordial One then led the Great Deities of Heavenly Truth, the High Sovereigns, the Perfected Ones of Wondrous Conduct, and the countless multitude of the Great Deities of the Transformation and Birth of Yin and Yang into the **center of the Divine Pearl**. The people below looked up and saw only a shimmering blur. Once they entered the mouth of the pearl, no one knew where they were. The people of the nation dispersed, and the earth returned to being level and upright; the singing ceased.

Inside the Divine Pearl, within a jewel palace, the Primordial One requested the Sovereigns of the various heavens to govern the regulation of Yin and Yang and the transformation of the heavens. These included the Jade Sovereigns of the Eight Directions, the Five Elders <note>the spirits of the five elements</note>, the Great Lord of Long Life, the Lord of the Eastern Ultimate Purple Morning, the Sovereign of the Upper Palace of Beautiful Splendor, the Ancestor of the Radiant Court, the Sovereign of the Primordial Breath, the Fiery Spirit of the Southern Radiance, the Water Emperor of the Northern Mystery, the Great Truth of the Central Yellow, the Spiritual Consort of the Jade Flower, the Mother of the Great Mystery Breath, and the Mother of the Ten Thousand Ways—the Ninefold Spiritual Wondrous Mother of Yin-Yang Transformation. He granted them their ranks and seated them. They could be seen from the ten directions as if through lapis lazuli. The light and Qi merged in darkness, and a song from the void raised its voice. The sound was graceful and elegant, and as the harmonious wind blew, the ten thousand things were generated and completed. The Primordial Celestial Worthy looked...

## Upper Register

The Celestial Worthy looked upon the assembly of immortals as they rotated in contemplation of the wondrous and beautiful heavens. They bowed in respect as dragons soared and tigers leaped. He manifested the "Five Wheels" <note>symbolizing the five elements or five directions</note> of purple-gold radiant light in a circular image. He then touched the curtains of flowing clouds and lush mountain waters, and leaned upon a desk of carved jasper and knotted pearls where "Golden Truth" flew with light.

He announced to the gathered Perfected Ones: "These Great Characters of the Heavenly Husband <note>original: *Tian Zhangfu*, a reference to the cosmic creative force</note> are the Primal Root of Yin and Yang. They exist in a state of indistinct blurring <note>original: *huang-hu*, the 'vague and elusive' state described in the *Dao De Jing*</note>. The Spirit serves as the gate of transformation, and the Breath (*Qi*) is the cause of life. The two substances of Yin and Yang originally had no names. Through their mutual succession, transformation occurs: one floats while the other sinks; one follows while the other opposes; one is hard while the other is soft; one is internal while the other is external. One is Yin, one is Yang; one is the Dragon, one is the Tiger. They embrace, conceive, and combine their essences. Thus, they give birth to the **Great Void** <gloss>21</gloss>.

The Great Void gave birth to the **Great Non-existence**; the Great Non-existence gave birth to the **Great Cavern**; the Great Cavern gave birth to the **Great Space**; the Great Space gave birth to the **Great Desert**. This 'Great Desert' exists at the furthest limit of the Mysterious Void. There, Yin and Yang intersect and change to produce the Two Poles <note>Heaven and Earth</note>. The Two Poles produce the Three Powers <note>Heaven, Earth, and Humanity</note>, and the Three Powers produce the Ten Thousand Things. Thus the Three Realms were fully equipped, and the Immortals and Perfected Ones took their stations. Golden Gates and Jade Cities, with millions of official chambers, arose. Mountains stood in rows, and rivers and seas surged. This is the ultimate principle of the Great Vessel of Creation from the Beginningless. From this, the High Sovereigns of the various heavens, the Great Emperors, the Immortal Sages, and the Wise also took their birth. Down to the Nine Offices, the Northern Hell, the Springs of the Underworld, and the spirits and demon marshals of the Nine Earths—all follow this same Way."

## Middle Register

"This is the subtle creation of Yang and the origin of the Great Vessel of Creation. Furthermore, there is the method of taking the essence of Yin and Yang, ascending and descending Water and Fire. With the Sun on the left and the Moon on the right, one contains the Great Non-existence within. By circulating the 'Nine-Nine' <note>a cycle of internal alchemy</note>, it condenses into the Purple Bloom. If you can ingest this, you will merge with the divine light and fly upward to the Heaven of Great Clarity. This is the Way of 'Supreme Harmony of the External Image' produced by Yin and Yang. These secrets are hidden in the 'Mysterious Viscera' and recorded in detail within the Golden Tablets and Jade Books. They are sealed in the Jade Capital of the Mysterious Capital, within the Palace of Jade Clarity of the High Sovereign, and inside the 'Vow of the Eastern Florescence' <gloss>22</gloss>."

When the law was first revealed, it brought infinite salvation to mankind. The Primordial One finished speaking the scripture inside the pearl. Riding upon the "True Supervision of Joy," he transmitted it to me <note>the narrator/disciple</note>. At that time, the celebration was beyond words. As the ritual concluded, the various heavens returned to their positions. In the time it takes to share a drink, all was silent, and no echoes remained. At that time, the heavenly beings who encountered this scripture and law were all saved. They clearly understood the process of transformation and birth, and their lifespans became as long as the heavens. The entire land turned in devotion to the source. All saw the Origin of the Way, the transformation of nature, the principle of change, the clarity of transformation, and the cause of transformation. Spirit was born, Breath (*Qi*) was born, Essence was born, Movement was born, and Matter was born. Their bodies possessed a jade-like radiance, and their voices resonated with the sound of the sunset clouds. All joined in compassion and love, forming a single family. The nation was at peace, the people were prosperous, and they danced with joy in a time of Great Peace. When the teaching first emerged, the entire nation followed the Way. Those who had a sincere heart and honored it with worship were all able to transcend the world.

The Way says: What the Primordial Celestial Worthy spoke in the scripture are the **Internal Names and Hidden Rhymes** of the High Sovereigns of the heavens. They are also the secret titles of the True Kings who govern the transformation of Yin and Yang. They are the hidden names of the hundred spirits, not the common language of the world.

## Lower Register

"Those who have already become Perfected Ones have researched the mysteries of the Way and can fully understand these chapters. By reciting them ten times, the various heavens will prosper from afar, and the ten thousand emperors will establish authority. The celestial waves will settle into auspiciousness, and purple mists will condense on the sea. The Sun and Moon will breathe out their radiance, and the 'Rotating Mechanism' <note>the Big Dipper</note> will return its light. The host of demons will be bound, and one’s essence will be refined to eliminate delusion. It can return the soul to the corpse and raise the dead, bringing life back to white bones. A student of the highest learning who recites it seven times will be guarded by the Five Emperors, and the Three Realms will bow in respect. The essence of demons will lose its sight, and the 'Forest of Delusion' will be extinguished. Those on the verge of death will be saved; those whose lives were cut off will live again. This is because the Breath of the Transformation of Yin and Yang is the root of beginning. To continue what is broken and heal what is wounded, one must rely on the root of life. Use the **Dao as the Father and Virtue as the Mother** <gloss>23</gloss>. Use the Spirit as the teacher and Life as the master. The foul breath will be entirely dispelled, and the body will gradually merge with the Truth."

"One can summon and command the ten directions, use majesty to restrain demon spirits, and subdue the earthly deities. Bind the 'evil spirits,' and death will be kept at bay—though one cannot be reborn if the scripture is recited carelessly. To recite it lightly will bring calamity to the body. But if you provide offerings and show honor, your household will flourish, and your descendants will prosper for generations. You will have good karmic conditions, and ten thousand disasters will not interfere. Divine beings will guard your gate. This scripture is uniquely wondrous in the Jade Capital. It brings infinite salvation and is the ancestor of the ten thousand Ways. Its grand model is so towering that its virtue is hard to surpass."

The Way says: Whenever this scripture is recited ten times, the various heavens arrive simultaneously. The suffering souls of billions of ancestors are immediately saved and ascend to the **Vermilion Palace** <note>a celestial realm of rebirth</note>. There, they undergo transformation for nine years and are reborn as persons of high rank. Those who love learning and complete their merit through the scripture will become divine immortals, flying up to the Golden Gates and feasting in the Jade Capital. Students of the highest caliber who practice this scripture will fly to the Southern Palace. Ordinary people who recite it will find that Yin and Yang harmonize naturally; the Way of Life enters their bodies, and their years are extended. Later, they may all achieve the **Way of Corpse Liberation** <term>Shijie: a form of 'fake' death where the physical body is left behind like a butterfly's cocoon while the spirit ascends</term>. Their souls will not be obscured and will not pass through the hells; they will immediately return to form and wander through the Great Space. This scripture is subtle and saves infinitely. All heavenly beings receive its blessings of boundless fortune. The living and the dead receive grace. It is a treasure of the upper heavens and is not lightly transmitted to the lower world, except to the most devoted seekers.

### The Sacred Vow and Divine Protection

By offering golden treasures as a pledge of the heart’s oath, the celestial law is transmitted. One must not treat this lightly, leak its secrets, or approach it with slow arrogance, for such actions bring consequences to one's lineage for seven generations. The officials of the dark realm are tasked with overseeing this scripture. They are accompanied by the Five Emperors <note>the Five Directional deities</note> and twenty-four Jade Boys and Jade Girls each, who guard the divine text and protect the body of the one who receives it.

The Way says:

**In the first month**, during a long fast, recite this scripture. It offers praise to Heaven and Earth for the seasonal transformations that bring life. Withered forests and dry stalks will all flourish in abundance. Even white bones and decaying remains will be reached by the "Heavenly Harmony" as it broadcasts its essence. The "True Fluid" <note>a metaphor for life-giving internal energy</note> will overflow within. This scripture also governs the "Life Talisman of the Great Mystery," which summons back the hundred spirits on behalf of the ancestors of the past seven generations, cutting off their forced labor in the underworld and delivering them to the **Southern Palace** <note>the realm of refined rebirth</note>.

**In the seventh month**, during a long fast, recite this scripture. The celestial perfected ones descend. Yin is transformed and Yang is born. The skin becomes firm, the five splendors <note>the health of the five internal organs</note> blossom into elegance, and the cinnabar radiance manifests a spiritual aura. One's name is recorded with "Golden Marrow and Jade Veins." The body attains the state of an immortal. The various heavens record the name upon the **Yellow Register and White Tablets** <gloss>ritual documents used to erase the name from the rolls of the dead and record it among the living</gloss>.

**In the tenth month**, during a long fast, recite this scripture. The "Mysterious One" is in front, the "True One" is behind, and the "Great One" dwells in the center. Yin and Yang merge their virtues. In a state of being "vague and elusive," the utmost spirit arrives in a state of "Great Simplicity." As the movement of the Way is renewed daily, it brings stability to the King and the Great Lords. Father and son, sovereign and minister, all find peace. The nation's destiny is preserved as long as the heavens. Generation after generation, the line remains unbroken, and the ruler peacefully governs his region while the people proclaim a time of **Great Peace** <note>original: *Taiping*, an idealized era of harmony and social justice</note>.

**On the days of the Eight Nodes** <note>the solstices, equinoxes, and the beginnings of the four seasons</note>, recite this scripture. The "Eight Brilliances" gather the spirits, and the **Original Breath** (*Yuanqi*) <term>Yuanqi: the primordial energy from which the universe is composed</term> intersects. Yang bestows and Yin receives, providing the substance for one's true nature. As the cycle returns, your name is recorded in the Golden Books. You may fly upward through the Eight Gates and Nine Chambers at will, becoming a "Perfected One of the Nine Palaces."

**On the day of one's birth**, recite this scripture. The "Embryonic Truth" begins its life, rooted in the Great Truth. Yin and Yang follow the Way, and heavenly blessings arrive naturally. The soul and spirit are fortified, and the myriad breaths all become immortal. Without undergoing the "trials of the dead," your lifespan will be stretched out. Your name will be fixed in the registers of the Heavenly Origin, and even the Great Demons will speak in your favor. The myriad spirits will bow in respect.

## Ritual Preparations

The Way says: On the day you practice the Way, you must bathe in fragrant water, observe the fast, and enter the quiet chamber. Facing East, **click your teeth thirty-two times** <note>a ritual act representing the 32 layers of the Daoist heavens</note>. Send your petition to the thirty-two heavens and bow from the heart thirty-two times. Close your eyes and meditatively visualize your body sitting in the midst of clouds and breath of three colors: blue, yellow, and white.

Inside and out, the atmosphere is deep and vast. The **Four Symbols** <note>the directional guardians</note>—the Blue Dragon, the White Tiger, the Vermilion Bird, and the Dark Warrior—along with lions and white cranes, are arrayed to your left and right. The Sun and Moon shine brightly, illuminating the interior of the room. Behind your head, a "circular image" <note>a halo or mandorla</note> arises, its light reflecting across the ten directions. When this is visualized clearly, whisper the following secret incantation:

"The Unsurpassed Mysterious Origin, the Highest Lord of the Way, I summon the 'Three-Five' Merit Officers within my body, the attendants of the left and right, the Jade Boys who serve the incense, and the Jade Girls who transmit words. I summon the 'Duty Officers of the Five Emperors' and the thirty-six Fragrance Officers of the day. Report that on this auspicious day, during this long fast in this pure hall, I practice the Supreme Scripture of Infinite Salvation. I pray that this report reaches the presence of the Unsurpassed Thirty-Two Heavens and the Primordial High Sovereigns."

After this, draw in breath thirty-two times and, facing East, begin reciting the scripture.
