# The Supreme Wondrous Scripture of the Primordial Infinite Salvation

The Numinous Treasure (Lingbao) Chapters on the Hidden Mystery of the Primordial, ten-fold transformations for the salvation of humanity.

In the beginning, the Primordial revealed the Chaos of Nature. Through vast eons, names were separated. Yin and Yang condensed their essence, containing the "True Breath" (*Zhenqi*). This encompassed the Great Image. When "Light" moved to its limit, it became "Purity"; when "Stillness" moved to its limit, it became the "Source."

The limit of Yang caused Yin to blow, and in response, the "Flying Elements" were transformed. The Dragon moans in the water; the Tiger roars in the mountain. The Dragon emerges from the fire. Through repeated cycles of transformation, the "Mysterious Waves" of "Subtle Existence" took shape from the "Void Limit." The "Five Movements" ground open the Golden Truth. Within the Heavenly King's palace and the Jasper Towers, among the nine emerald peaks of the Great Mountain, the "Master of Myriad Spirits" reviews the accounts.

Ten thousand immortals vibrate with "Jade Essence." The "Cloud Chapters" and "Treasure Pieces" consist of sixty-four styles of script, which branch out into eight thousand variations. As the breaths of Yin and Yang intersect, they produce the **Vermilion Script** <note>original: *Chiwen*, the sacred 'red' celestial calligraphy</note>. Without this script, there is no divinity. Without this script, there is no light. Without this script, nothing is established or formed. Without this script, there is no transformation or ascension. This is the "Heaven within the Brahma-Heavens."

In the state of "vague presence and absence," the True Way drives the cycles. The "Flying Omen" <note>the practitioner</note> understands this subtle transformation and becomes an immortal. What an immortal prizes is long life—breath after breath, continuous and unending. The **Phoenix Seal Script** <note>sacred celestial writing</note> of the Nine Heavens reaches up to the Great Mystery. The "Brahma-Breath" of the ten directions circulates everywhere.

They return the spirit to the skeleton and raise the dead. This is the "Infinite Salvation of Mankind." Today, the accounts are reviewed across the heavens as the divine presence descends:

## The Chapter on the Primordial Essence of the Great One

The Way says: Long ago, in the Great Central Primordial Yellow Realm, within the Purple Void of the Golden-Jade Domain, the Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning <note>the personification of the starting point of the universe</note> received the "Infinite Supreme Primordial Essence of the Great One." As the Celestial Worthy preached this scripture, he completed ten ritual circuits. On the first circuit, the great gods of the Heavenly Truth, the high sages and exalted ones, and the Perfected Ones of Wondrous Conduct gathered. These included the Yellow Lord, the Primal Emperor, and the Wondrous Vacuity Perfected Lord of the Great One’s Primordial Essence. Additionally, the Thirty-Six Emperor-Lords of the Nine Levels of the Center, the Immortal Kings, and the great gods of the Earthly Truth arrived. Countless officials from the spiritual and celestial bureaus rose into the air. Yellow clouds and emerald mists appeared; green carriages with jasper wheels and vermilion flowers cast their shade. The jade-light of the Primordial Essence and the shimmering radiance of auspicious colors illuminated the Great Void for five days and five nights. The divine spirits of the Great One <note>original: Taiyi</note> filled the mountain peaks and celestial palaces. The solar and lunar mansions, the stars, and the constellations were crowded with dragon-carriages. The celestial machinery paused its rapid pace as the calendar itself slowed to a solidified glow, turning the world into the color of gold. A cold, quiet, and refreshing breeze blew. The celestial valleys grew deep and still. Green smoke and faint light shone through the emerald sky. Purple mists and flying fogs stabilized the Three Primaries, and the four breaths became subtle and clear. The mountains, rivers, and forests of the land became peaceful and level like a whetstone, with no more heights or depths, all covered in thick, golden auspiciousness.

The seasons radiated with beautiful colors, and the palaces of pale-blue mist showed no discord. As the many perfected ones sat in attendance, the Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning sat suspended in the void upon a throne of five-colored dragons. After he recited the scripture once, the Great Sages of the heavens praised its goodness. At that time, the men and women of the nation watched with focused minds as the heavens, the lands, the mountains, the seas, the jeweled pavilions, the immortals, and the ghosts and spirits were all born and took their forms. After the scripture was recited twice, they contemplated the flow of the sun and moon.

As the rivers and seas poured forth, the people wondered upon what force they relied to remain suspended in the void. After the scripture was recited three times, all heavenly beings turned their inner light to gaze within; their breath entered the Profound Primordial, and their path aligned with the Vacuous Truth. After the scripture was recited four times, all heavenly beings looked up and down through the Three Realms <note>the realms of desire, form, and formlessness</note>; clouds moved, winds blew, and plants reached their auspicious peak. After the scripture was recited five times, they attained the realization of the source of transformation—the True Earth of the Nine Forms of the Great One’s Primordial Essence <note>a technical term in internal alchemy referring to the stabilizing "earth" element within the body</note>. Through this resonance, they were reborn. After the scripture was recited six times, their spiritual hearts suddenly opened; they knew the proper measure of Yin and Yang and how the ten thousand things are brought to completion. After the scripture was recited seven times, the mysterious currents overflowed, the "King’s Fungus" <note>a mythical plant of immortality</note> grew spontaneously, and the Dragon and Tiger roared in mourning as they realized the nature of Dharma-forms. After the scripture was recited eight times, their bodies were refined into the image of the Void, transforming into "Suchness" <note>original: Zhenru; a state of ultimate reality</note>. This spiritual power was considered exceptionally rare. After the scripture was recited nine times, the great assembly was filled with joy; they beheld the Primordial Beginning and understood the mechanisms of the universe and the mystery of the Primordial Essence. After the scripture was recited ten times, celestial music flowed in rhythm, all species cried out in unison, and the jade-like forms were filled with floral joy, as deep as the void itself. At this time, every man and woman in the nation turned their hearts toward the teachings, receiving protection and attaining long life.

### The Supreme Wondrous Scripture of the Primordial Beginning for Infinite Universal Salvation

This is the Original Chapter of the Numinous Treasure from the Primordial Cavern, the Highest Head of the Primordial Essence of the Great One, the "Hidden Rhythms of the Yellow Court" <note>celestial sounds related to the internal 'Yellow Court' or center of the body</note> for saving people and binding the hundred demons. The Supreme True Primordial Beginning, the Ancestral Earth of the Great One, is called the "Great Void." This Void is the Ancestral Earth of the Great One. Its Primordial Essence nurtures the Three Realms and gives birth to the various heavens, bringing light to the three luminaries <note>sun, moon, and stars</note>; this is the Root of Heaven. Above it, there is no further ancestor; the Way itself is its body. There is no boundary and no emptiness that is not this Earth. Above the Earth of the Void, the Void is the Mother of the Way. ## Section 3: The Song of the True King of the Primordial Essence of the Great One

In the morning I ascend the Altar of the Great Primordial,
In the evening I feast at the source of the Heavenly River.
In the human world, two kalpas <note>vast cycles of time</note> have already passed,
But in the Langfeng Paradise <note>a peak of Mt. Kunlun</note>, the spring is forever fresh.
With starlight feathers I straighten my lofty crown,
With dragon reins I drive the divine wind.
The journey through the empyrean is beyond counting miles,
Purple clouds appear only as a dim morning light.
The Jade Maidens strike the Geng-bell <note>original: Minggeng</note>,
The clear sounds are naturally vast and lonely.
They call out to those lost in the vast kalpas,
Calling them to joyously ascend the waves of the clouds.
Fragrant smoke rises from the green windows,
Crimson brocade returns to the purple empyrean.
Emerald colors startle the tall towers,
The banners of the empyrean flutter with the clouds.
A colorful rainbow extends across the jasper frame,
Ten thousand immortals dance with numinous jade.
The worlds are measured as three thousand,
All are molded and shaped by the True Soil.
Those who do not know the Mother of the Way and Virtue
Entrust themselves to the sages, rushing toward the celestial flutes.
Pity those struggling within the dust of the world;
I sing this while leaning against the numinous mechanism of the stars.

> These are the songs of the True King flying within the air above the Three Realms. The sounds are integrated with the "Chapters of the Cavern." Chanting them a hundred times records one’s name in the Southern Palace <note>the office of rebirth and immortality</note>. Chanting them a thousand times ensures the True King will personally welcome you. Chanting them ten thousand times completes the Way, allowing one to fly up into the Great Void, surpass the Three Realms, and attain the rank of Duke of the Immortals. Whenever these numinous sounds are heard, the True Kings show respect and issue commands; the Earth Spirits stand guard and offer welcome. One is pulled out of the Gates of the Earth and the "Five Sufferings and Eight Hardships." The ancestors of seven generations are promoted and ascend, forever leaving the offices of the ghosts. The soul is ferried to the Vermilion Mound <note>original: Zhuling</note> to undergo refinement and be reborn. This is called "Infinite Universal Salvation without end." These are secret heavenly texts, revered by all the heavens. To leak them or treat them with arrogance will lead to the hells and bring disaster upon the ancestors of seven generations.

The Way says: These two chapters are the secret sounds of the Emperors of the various heavens and the Most Numinous True Kings. They point to the "True Soil" as the destination of the Way. The Primordial Essence of the Great One nurtures radiance and brings blessings to the body so that no misfortune or decay occurs. Its nature is like gold or the "Child of the Empty Soil" who follows the "Mother of Harmony." Stabilize and guard it, never letting it leave for a single breath. The Great Primordial Mountain has grand structures and twin streams. Drawing in its breath, the earth relies upon it for support. Eliminate the "View of Emptiness" <note>the false belief that the void is merely nothingness</note>; within the Soil, the Breath can supplement the Spirit. When Breath and Spirit blend, the "Gates of Death" are naturally sealed. These are general words, not the common language of the world. The words have no unnecessary embellishment, and the melodies have no worldly floweriness; thus they are called "Mysterious and Profound," difficult to investigate in detail. They are treasures of the High Heavens, kept secret in the Palace of the Jade Purity King of the Divine Empyrean in the Mysterious Capital. The Great Sovereign of the Water-Cycle <note>original: Ren-Chen Dajun</note> descends to receive these teachings and pass them on. If there is a person of high virtue who offers gold and treasures and whose heart follows the ancient rules, announce the covenant to the Ten Heavens and then transmit it to them.

The Way says: When the cycles of Heaven and Earth reach their end, and the Sun, Moon, and Five Stars lose their fullness, even the Most Holy and Divine Men pause. Students of the end times may suffer from illness or injury. When such disasters occur, all those of the same Breath should unify their hearts and practice the ritual of purification. At the six designated hours, offer incense and circumambulate the scripture ten times. Blessings and virtue will immediately descend, and all inauspiciousness will be eliminated. These infinite texts provide universal salvation without end.

The Way says: If a student’s knowledge of the Way is shallow, or if their rank among the immortals is not yet attained when they face death and pass through the "Great Yin," their fellow students of high virtue should offer incense for them and chant the scripture ten times to save the "Corpse-Form." If done according to the law, the Great One will protect the dwelling, the Primordial Essence will nourish the form, and the True King will guard the life-force. The Life-Qi will rise, and the soul and spirit will go straight to the Southern Palace. Based on the merit of their studies, the days will be counted, and they will attain rebirth and transformation; they will not be lost, but will immediately attain the status of a Divine Immortal.

The Way says: When the cycles of Heaven and Earth end, the constellations fall into disorder, the Sun and Moon lose their light, the four seasons lose their order, and Yin and Yang are not harmonized. When the land suffers disasters of war, punishment, ghosts, or thieves, or when plagues and toxins spread, causing the death and injury of the people, or when teachers and friends pass away and the law-students face misfortune—then one should also practice the ritual of purification, offer incense, and chant the scripture. The merit of fasting and chanting is extremely heavy. Above, it eliminates heavenly disasters and protects the Emperor; below, it repels poisonous harms to save the people. All living beings receive and rely upon these blessings; they are difficult to surpass. Thus it is called "Infinite Universal Salvation of Heavens and Humans."

The Way says: Anyone who possesses this scripture and can perform this merit for the sake of Heaven, Earth, the Emperor, and the people—on the days of disaster, if they resolve their hearts to practice the ritual, burn incense, and chant ten times, all the heavens will record their names, and ten thousand spirits will stand guard. This distinguishes the person of high virtue as a minister of the Golden Court of the Holy Sovereign. The heavens record human merit and error to the smallest degree. The True Kings of the Heavens will also protect and recommend your body. Those who attain the Way should thoroughly understand these "Most High Words."

## Chapter of the Solar Essence and Yang Radiance

The Way says: Long ago, in the Heaven of Crimson Brightness <note>one of the great kalpa-eras of Taoist cosmology</note>, within the Land of the Purple Yang’s Ethereal Song and Great Treasure Light, the Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning received the "Infinite Higher Prime of the Solar Essence and Yang Radiance for the Salvation of Humanity." As the Celestial Worthy was about to speak this scripture, he summoned the ten directions ten times over. At the start, the Great Spirits of the Heavenly Truth, the High Saints and Exalted Sovereigns, the Perfected Ones of Wondrous Conduct, and the Emperor of the Sun of the Cavernous Yang <note>the personification of the sun</note> arrived. They were accompanied by the Empress, the imperial consorts, and countless celestial officials and citizens of the sun, all riding through the void. They arrived on crimson clouds and cinnabar mists, in green carriages with jasper wheels, shaded by flowery canopies. 

The solar essence and Yang light burst forth in nine colors, brilliantly illuminating the Great Void. For seven days and seven nights, the stars and constellations of the various heavens emitted flying essences and trailing rays of light, their brilliance interlacing and reflecting throughout the heights of the void. The Divine Palace grew still; the Heavenly Pivot <note>the axis of the universe</note> stopped its rotation; the Jade Dipper and Golden Balance <note>astronomical instruments of the heavens</note> stood frozen in anticipation. The divine winds grew silent, and the mountains and seas concealed their clouds. The celestial landscape became one of pure Yang radiance, with Qi flowing like mist. Throughout the land, the mountains, forests, and trees all became perfectly level, with no high or low ground. The earth itself turned to red jade, uniform in color. 

As the many Perfected Beings sat in attendance, the Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning sat upon a law-throne of the Nine-Dragon Yang Radiance, shimmering with pearls and jewels. When he had recited the scripture once, the Great Saints of the various heavens all praised the goodness of the teaching. At that time, the men and women of the land looked up to see the solar essence sparkling in nine paths of Yang-radiance mist, spreading through the heavens. They came to believe that this True Essence is the ancestor of the ten thousand things. 

When the scripture was recited a second time, the palaces within the sun became visible, and the celestial immortals and citizens there all returned to the Right Way. 

When the scripture was recited a third time, the world within the sun, held up by the "Hard Wind" <note>the cosmic wind that supports the heavens</note>, stood independent in the void, traveling in an infinite cycle. 

When the scripture was recited a fourth time, the jasper wheels of the celestial carriages drove through the clouds, and purple-gold light gathered to shine downward without limit, bringing the world's crops to beautiful...

...ripeness. When the scripture was recited a fifth time, the "Great Brahma" celestial scripts were all seen within the sun. Bleached skeletons and white bones <note>the neglected dead</note> looked up to receive the warm dawn; following the light, they ascended and escaped the Sea of Gloom. 

When the scripture was recited an eighth time, the vermilion light spread to the four directions. Jade and stone, containing essence, felt the touch of the Yang souls and all transformed into cinnabar blossoms. 

When the scripture was recited a ninth time, those dwelling in cavern chambers and craggy peaks—the hidden immortals and those refining their truth—drew in the solar light and rushed toward the dawn, causing their "Ancestral Roots" <note>spiritual foundations</note> to flourish. 

When the scripture was recited a tenth time, the solar essence paused in an auspicious sign. The dregs of the ten thousand things solidified, and the "Golden Liquid" <note>an alchemical term for refined spiritual essence</note> flowed outward, causing withered and decayed things to bear fruit. ### The Wondrous Scripture of the Precious Pearl Spoken by the Primordial Beginning

The Way says: Within the assembly, as the crowd looked on from all four directions, the Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning stretched out an arm of purple-gold light. He was clothed in a robe of nine-colored, rounded, and solid "Fire-Jade" <note>original: 'huoyu'—a mystical gemstone associated with solar energy</note> that hung in shimmering patterns. Using his great divine power, he extended his arm thirty-three thousand miles and reached down to pluck the solar disc as if he were picking a sweet fruit. The brilliant color of the fire stood poised and still, its light radiating in the ten directions, coming from the empty mystery. The solar disc was round and lustrous; within it were mountains, forests, rivers, seas, palaces, and city walls, with countless celestial citizens wandering there in free-spirited ease. It appeared like true lapis lazuli containing a golden hue. The devas and humans of the assembly all drew near to observe it.

Then, the Primordial Beginning transformed this solar disc into a **Precious Pearl**. It was as small as a grain of millet <note>This is a central Taoist metaphor: the "Precious Pearl of the Primordial Beginning" represents the entire universe contained within a single microscopic point of origin</note>, suspended in the empty mystery ninety feet above the ground. The Primordial Beginning then led the Great Spirits of the Heavenly Truth up into the high, tiered pavilion within it. The Perfected Ones of Wondrous Conduct, the Emperor and Empress of the Sun, and the countless great spirits—a vast, uncounted multitude—all entered into the Precious Pearl. The devas and humans looked up and saw them swirling like a mist as they entered the opening of the pearl. Once they had entered, their location could no longer be perceived. The people of the land were spread out far and wide; the earth became level and upright, and there were no longer any pits or mountain collapses. Within the Precious Pearl, the Primordial Beginning finished speaking the scripture, and the many Perfected Beings oversaw its completion. 

It was then bestowed upon me. At that time, the joy and celebration were beyond words. The ritual matters were roughly concluded, and the various heavens returned to their positions. In an instant, all was silent, and no sound remained. At this time, the devas and humans who followed this scripture and its laws were all saved, completing their natural lifespan without any premature harm. The entire land turned toward the teaching, forming ranks of devotees. My heart became clear in the Way, clear in truth, clear in the law, and clear in the precepts; clear in principle, clear in Yin and Yang, clear in spirit, and clear in Qi. My words harmonized with the cavernous chapters, and my mouth made no reckless sounds. We became equal in compassion and love, and though of different bones, we became as kin. The country grew peaceful, the people prosperous, and all rejoiced in Great Peace <note>Taiping—the utopian state of cosmic and social harmony</note>. When the scripture was first taught, the whole nation followed the Way with a sincere heart, honoring and worshipping it, and all were able to transcend the world.

The Way says: The words spoken within this scripture by the Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning are all the **Hidden Rhythms of the Inner Names of the Sovereign Within the Sun**. By using the Solar Essence to seal one's practice, one has not yet regulated the heavenly governance, but one's virtue can subdue and manage the earth spirits and bind the demon souls. This can prevent death, but it cannot yet grant rebirth. If one recites this chapter lightly or disrespectfully, their person shall suffer calamity. But for those who offer worship and respect, their households shall flourish. Generation after generation will prosper with good karmic connections; ten thousand disasters shall not interfere, and the divine spirits will guard their gates. ### Wondrous Scripture of the Supreme Prime of Primordial Universal Salvation

**The Chapter of the Primordial Hidden Mystery and Spiritual Jewel: The Solar Essence of Yang Radiance, the Supreme Radiant Salvation of Humanity.** The hundred demons are hidden in the rhythms; the separation and union of elements occur naturally. This song of the True King, echoing through the Three Realms and flying through the void, is part of the "Cavern Chapters." These are the secret writings of the high heavens, honored by all the celestial realms. The Tao says: These two chapters are the hidden sounds of the Five Emperors within the sun and the Divine King **Yuyi**. They clearly manifest the Way of "Solar Essence and Yang-Brightness," following the light through its rising and setting to save the "Perfected Ones." The Three Realms rely on these sounds to find enlightenment; the two polarities (Heaven and Earth) hold to them to remain distinct. If a practitioner can inhale the energy of the sun's essence and the core radiance of Yang-Brightness, then the "Golden Flower" will transform them into an immortal, and their seven generations of ancestors will be refined. 

These are all **Great Brahma Words** <note>original: "Da Fan," celestial speech that predates human language</note>. They are not the common verses of the world. They have no standard rhyme, yet their melody is beautiful; they have no worldly floweriness, yet they are graceful. Thus, they are called "dark and profound," difficult to investigate in detail. They are treasures of the high heavens, kept secret in the Jade Clarity Palace of the Divine Empyrean within the Mysterious Capital. When the Lord of the Way descends to the world, he allows them to circulate according to the cycles of fate. If a person of high virtue offers gold or treasures as a pledge, and their heart follows the ancient rules, they may declare their oath to the ten heavens and receive these teachings.

When the divine people are in distress, or when students of the later ages suffer from illness or injury, and all share in such calamities, they should all purify their hearts and perform the "Six Hours of Incense Ritual." By turning the scroll and reciting this scripture ten times, blessings and merit will immediately descend, and all ill omens will be extinguished. The "Limitless Text" saves all without end.

The Tao says: If a student’s knowledge of the Way is shallow, or if their immortal rank is not yet full, and they reach the time when their life-cycle ends and they must pass through the "Great Yin" <note>death</note>, then their fellow practitioners of high virtue should perform the incense ritual and recite this scripture ten times for them. This will benefit the physical corpse according to the law: the solar essence will flow down, and the "Yang-Brightness" will open the "Yin-bones" <note>the mortal remains</note>. The refined energy will merge with the celestial truth. The spirit-soul will go directly to the Southern Palace. Based on the merit of their studies, after a calculated number of days, they will be reborn into a new cycle <gloss>fourteen</gloss> and attain the rank of a Divine Immortal.

The Tao says: When the cycles of Heaven and Earth come to an end, the stars and constellations move out of order, the sun and moon lose their brilliance, the four seasons lose their measure, and Yin and Yang are not harmonized, then the land will suffer disasters and plagues will spread. When the people die in great numbers...

...and teachers or friends pass away, one should also perform the ritual of purification, burning incense, and reciting the scripture. The merit of fasting and reciting scriptures is extremely heavy. Above, it extinguishes celestial disasters and protects the Emperor; below, it repels poisonous harms and brings joy to the people. Both the living and the dead rely on its blessings, which are difficult to surpass. Thus, it is called the "Limitless Universal Salvation of Heavens and Humans."

The Tao says: Anyone who possesses this scripture and can perform these meritorious deeds for the sake of Heaven, Earth, the Emperor, and the people—on days of disaster, if they set their heart on purification, burn incense, and recite the scripture ten times—the various heavens will record their name, and ten thousand gods will stand guard. This distinguishes the "Perfected One" as a candidate to become a minister of the Golden Portal and a Holy Sovereign. The heavens record human merits and faults down to the smallest hair; nothing is lost. The True King in Heaven will also support your body. Only those who attain the Way can truly understand these ultimate words.

Within the land of the red doors and long towers of the Solar Court, utilizing the light of the Yang-deity **Yuyi**, this Way is most restricted. # The Taoist Canon

When solitary Yang ceases its calamities and condensed Yin pauses its transformations, the two breaths <note>Qi</note> merge in the darkness. **The Way says:** Within the cycles of heaven, there are times when the movements of the sun, moon, and five planets fall into imbalance or reach a state of exhaustion. ## Chapter on Yin and Yang Separating and Merging, the Five Elements Transforming the Body

**The Way says:** Long ago, within the Heaven of Profound Transformation, amidst the spiritual songs of Original Light, the Great Truth transformed the land. For nine days and nine nights, the cycles of Yin and Yang in the various heavens, the movements of the two luminaries <note>the sun and moon</note>, and the Three Primes <note>Sanyuan: the beginning of heaven, earth, and water</note> all paused their machinery. When he recited the scripture the **eighth time**, all within the borders were peaceful, prosperous, and joyful, ensuring the longevity of the era. 

When he recited the scripture the **ninth time**, social customs became pure and honest, and people focused solely on the Truth of the Way. 

When he recited the scripture the **tenth time**, both the living and the dead received blessings, relying universally on the profound grace.

Within the Thirty-two Heavens and under the Thirty-two Emperors, there are the "Hidden Secret Names of the Heavens." These are the spiritual chapters of the hollow void and spontaneous nature found within the heavens. They are the "Hidden Rhythms of the Heavens," the sounds of Yin and Yang, and the honored spirits of the Five Elements. They represent the spirits of **separation and merging** <note>Lihe: the process by which primordial energy divides into many forms and returns to unity</note>, which spontaneously transform the body and possess the spiritual power of exhaustive change. Through the "Nine Harmonies" and "Ten Unions," they transform within the Highest Purity and the infinite mysteries, the depths of which cannot be fully counted. These spirits descend to universally save both heavenly beings and humans.

Today, we rely on this celebration to receive salvation. We pray that the various heavens will summon the Yin and call the Yang, gathering and dispersing the "spread-falling" energies. May the Spring not be scorched by fire, let the heat of Summer follow, let the Metal of Autumn nurture the Water, and let the cold of Winter prevail. As the Four Seasons move the Earth, the ten thousand things are born and made complete.

The "Three Energies" transform the physical form, separating and merging at the dark gate. As the "Two Luminaries" <note>the Sun and Moon</note> rise and change, the Five Elements are distinguished. The Three Energies congeal into essence, dispersing and leaping like a smelting furnace, sometimes flying, sometimes hidden, sometimes sinking, and sometimes manifest. The Way acts through its "separation." The Three Realms stand upright, ten thousand vows are all settled, and through repeated separation and merging, the divine essence is broadcast and proclaimed. The Jade Cinnabar congeals, and the physical form is fully equipped as a spiritual likeness. The body transforms ten thousand times, yet remains the One Truth of Spontaneous Nature.

The True Lord holds the wheel and opens the Gates of Heaven. In the East, the Dipper generates Yang; in the West, the Dipper gives birth to Yin. As Yin and Yang descend from the Dippers, the spirit of Metal and the soul of Wood interact. There is the Mysterious Pool of the Northern Dipper, the Red Radiance of the Southern Dipper, and the Central Dipper which governs and manages all the various spirits. The **Green Emperor** <note>associated with the East and Wood</note> brings forth life; the **White Emperor** <note>West and Metal</note> completes the form; the **Red Emperor** <note>South and Fire</note> nourishes and sustains; the **Black Emperor** <note>North and Water</note> communicates with the essence; and the **Yellow Emperor** <note>Center and Earth</note> fixes wisdom and audits the records of the ten thousand spirits.

The **Demon Kings of the Five Heavens** <note>In this context, "Demon Kings" are powerful celestial governors who control disruptive forces and protect the scripture</note> are:
*   The Demon King of the Green Heaven, Ba Yuan Chou Bo.
*   The Demon King of the Red Heaven, Fu Tian Dan Shi.
*   The Demon King of the White Heaven, Fan Shan Liu Mu.
*   The Demon King of the Black Heaven, Jian Chou Lang Fu.
*   The Demon King of the Yellow Heaven, Heng Tian Dan Li.

These Great Demons of the Five Emperors are the ancestors of the ten thousand spirits. Following the "Qi," they separate and merge, their bodies transforming and circulating everywhere. They soar and expand through the mists, becoming companions to the Way. They establish the "Great Vessel" and distribute the "Nine Mounds." They manage Heaven and Earth and hold the divine soldiers in their grasp. Covering the talismans and clutching the ceremonial staffs, they fly through the Great Void. They call themselves "Illustrious and Grand," consulting on the destruction of evil and the manifestation of auspicious dragons. They ride the fine horses of the heavens, preceded by the red-armored warriors who raise banners of fire extending ten thousand miles. With "Flowing Bells" striking in the eight directions, any who dare to interfere with or obstruct the High Perfected Ones will be scorched by the spiritual chapters. The great army follows, harmonizing Yin and Yang, showing mercy to the good but executing the wicked spirits.

In the early morning, the records are fixed; the auditing and examination never stop. No demon may trespass, and no ghost may hide its form. The various bureaus of the Six Heavens investigate the ghost camps. No concealment is permitted, as the "Wind and Fire Express Stars" announce the news everywhere. Let the Ten Thousand Spirits of the Three Primordials all listen: The assistants of the Nine Abyss report to the Highest Purity. The records are examined in the vastness of the "Great Beginning" and the "Dragon Source."

Through the far-off hundreds of millions of eons, within the primordial chaos, Yin and Yang separated and merged. The "Five Natures" were spontaneously born, and the transformed bodies resided in the void. Above, they reached the limit of the "Three Colors"; below, they reached the deepest depths. They revolve through the "Nine Celebrations" on the "Golden Vehicle." Above the heavens and below the heavens, there is nothing too obscure, nothing too solid. Without form and without shadow, they are infinite and inexhaustible. The pure, blended energy entwines in the vastness. The Cinnabar Radiance opens the map; the cycles of the eons are spontaneous. The **Primordial Beginning** <note>Yuanshi: the highest deity/state of the universe</note> settles and calms the world, spreading the Five Chapters, the Jade Characters of the Red Book, and the Dragon Script of the Eight Powers. These preserve and regulate the cycles of the eons, causing the heavens to endure forever. The Brahma-Qi spreads everywhere, and the ten thousand models are opened wide. The net-cord of the universe flows...

The Thirty-Two Heavens revolve through the Formless, circling the ten directions, rotating through the Dipper and passing through the Winnowing Basket <note>referring to the constellations of the Big Dipper and the Winnowing Basket (Sagittarius)</note>. They cycle through the blessings of the "Five Constancies" <note>the five virtues or cosmic norms</note>, as the totalizing energy of the Thirty-Five Portions of the Supreme Prime merges with the Eight Sceneries in the darkness. Within the Mystery of Mysteries, the Great Emperor of the Highest Sovereign dwells. Amidst the deep shadows and great rosy clouds, he chants the "Cavern Stanzas." The Golden Perfected ones radiate fragrance, their sounds echoing through the cloud encampments. The Jade Tones gather the energy, as the spiritual winds collect the mists. The Purple Void is lush and elegant, providing wings for ten thousand immortals.

All of this arises from the separation and merging <term>Lihe: the process by which primordial unity divides into the many forms of the universe and eventually returns to one</term> of Yin and Yang, and the transformation of the Five Elements <note>Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, and Water</note> into physical forms. These manifest as the subtle energy of creation, allowing the Correct Way to open and the Ultimate Truth to be proclaimed. 

Within this process dwell the great spirits: the Great Lord of Long Life, the Great Emperor of the Radiant Green, the Divine Sovereign of White Purity, the Great Unity <note>Taiyi</note>, the Director of Destinies, the Clear-Reasoning Lord, the Peach-Health Lord, and the Emperor of Life-Extension. They hold the tallies and grasp the registers, protecting the roots of life. Above, they wander through the Nine Purities; they enter and exit the "Yellow Chamber" within the Mysterious Cinnabar and the "Crimson Palace." Below, they stabilize the six lungs and the cavernous depths to nourish the essence. In the center, they regulate the five energies, blending the hundred spirits. Through ten rotations, the spirits return; through ten thousand energies, one becomes an immortal. 

The Way of the Immortals prizes life; it is the immeasurable salvation of humanity. It opens the Eight Gates of the high heavens and the "Flying Wheel of the Law." It governs the prohibitions of sin and blessing, and the causal conditions of past lives. It offers universal salvation to the souls of the dead and the bodies of the living. Once a body receives this salvation, the gates of the various heavens are opened. Above each heaven is a Gate of Life, and within each gate are the "Chapters of the Transformed Bodies of Separation and Merging." These are the spiritual passages of the True Kings, whose words are joined with the Highest Perfected.

### I. The Sound of Separation and Merging Flying through the Void

Once the Single Qi <note>the primordial breath of the universe</note> was opened,
The ten thousand transformations flowed through.
Yin and Yang separated and merged,
As the Great Eon completed its cycle.
The Nine Heavens and the Eight Extremities,
The thirty-two mountain passes—
Through every separation and every merging,
The count of the energy shifts and moves.
The brilliant primordial symbols
Respond below within the human body.
The sprawling palaces and watchtowers
Are fully equipped with the hundred spirits.

If you wish to sever the cycle of reincarnation,
Follow and cultivate the Five Elements.
The transformation of the Five Elements
Is the very Origin of Heaven.
If you can recognize this,
Your physical form shall lift as a flying immortal.
If the spiritual palace is turbid and dark,
One cannot achieve the Way.
How can one understand the awakening to the Way?
Spirit and Energy must ascend together.
As Yin and Yang separate and merge,
The ten thousand things follow the light.
Wandering freely, you pass beyond the Three Realms <note>the realms of Desire, Form, and Formlessness</note>,
And naturally, there is no more birth or death.
The spirit flies, treading the Circular Net,
As the twin palace gates shine for the High Perfected.

### II. The Chapter of the Perfected One’s Transformed Body

Driving a carriage, I wander through the eight darknesses,
Resting my gaze upon the slopes of Mount Kunlun.
At the Golden Gate, I pay respects to the Emperor of the Void,
Riding the great rosy clouds upon phoenixes and herons.
The transformed body exists within the empty void,
Born and completed by washing in the mysterious waves.
When the physical form is restrained by unexhausted desires,
The dark thoughts have no shore or limit.
Thought after thought, they chase one another,
Sinking endlessly into the river of attachment.
Once fallen into the realm of filth and turbidity,
One knows only the way of suffering and songs of grief.
I now spread the Ultimate Teaching,
To block the source of evil with Correct Energy.
The "Crimson Script" brings joy to all beings,
The "Yellow Flag" summons the Great Demons.
Forever enjoy great blessings,
For which a hundred million years are not too many.
Alas, you children within the dust—
How can you turn your backs on the Truth?

### III. The Song of the Five Elements and Yin-Yang

Vast and far above the Three Heavens,
Lofty is the White Jade Capital.
The Primordial Beginning <note>Yuanshi</note> commands the bright sceneries,
Establishing the root of this Great Transformation.
Yin is born, congealing the Yellow Blossom;
The solar light spreads the Crimson Wheel.
The two energies entwine and lace together,
As the Five Elements flow through the Great Void.
The Seven Sceneries <note>the sun, moon, and five planets</note> soar and transform,
And the ten thousand species arise from this.
The Five Elements shift and change one another;
Who can measure their failure or success?
In the Divine Empyrean, the Dark Record is held,
To audit all the beings of the heavens.
To the left, it gathers the demons of the Three Realms;

To the right, it restrains the armies of the Six Heavens.
The Precious Chapter summons the Energy of Harmony,
The Jade Talisman assembles the hundred spirits.
The Heavenly Soldiers grasp the jasper axes,
As the Red Emperor casts down flowing gold.
Capturing the ugly hordes of demons,
The lands are all made clear and pure.
The entire heaven is covered by the shadow of Truth,
Preserved for billions of eons without collapsing.

These songs and sounds of the True Kings, flying through the void above the Three Realms, are joined with the "Cavern Stanzas." Reciting them one hundred times will register your name in the Southern Palace. Reciting them one thousand times will cause the True Kings to personally welcome you. Reciting them ten thousand times completes the Way, and you will ascend through the Great Void, passing beyond the Three Realms to take your place among the Immortal Lords. Upon hearing these spiritual sounds, the True Kings change their forms and command the Earth Spirits to stand guard and escort you. You will be pulled out from the "Earth Door" <note>the realm of the dead</note>, and after the Five Sufferings and Eight Hardships, your ancestors of seven generations will be promoted, forever leaving the ghostly offices. Their souls will pass through the Crimson Hill, receive the registers of life, and be reborn. This is called the immeasurable and universal salvation that never ends. These are the secret texts of the high heavens, honored by all the heavens. To leak them or treat them with slow arrogance will cause one to fall into hell, bringing calamity upon one's ancestors back seven generations.

The Way says: These two chapters are both the secret sounds of the Emperors of the Heavens and the High Spirit Immortal Kings. They are not the ordinary words or refined lyrics of the world; they are ultimate, profound, and difficult to examine in detail. They are the treasures of the high heavens, kept secret in the Jade Purity Palace of the Divine Empyrean and the Scripture Room of the Eastern Brilliance. After the passage of many cycles, they are transmitted downward according to the mysterious laws. If there is a person of ultimate virtue who offers gold and treasures and whose heart follows the old rules, they may swear an oath to the True King, and then these shall be bestowed upon them.

The Way says: The movements of Heaven and Earth have their endings; the sun, moon, and five stars have their waxings and wanings. These are all manifestations of the separation, merging, and transformation of Yin and Yang. Whenever such calamities occur...

## Chapter on the Green Yang of the Fusang Tree
<note>Fusang is the mythical world-tree in the East where the sun rises; Green Yang (Qingyang) refers to the restorative, life-giving energy of the East and the Wood element.</note>

The Way says: Long ago, within the Heaven of the Numinous Treasure, amidst the reflected clouds of the Green Sprouts <note>the primordial essence of the East</note>, the Great Brahma generated the soil. There, the "Limitless Upper Chapters of the Green Yang of Fusang" were received from the Primordial Beginning. When the Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning <term>Yuanshi Tianzun: The highest deity in the Daoist trinity, representing the beginning of the universe</term> was to speak this scripture, he orbited ten times to summon the Great Spirits of the ten directions.

All the High Sovereigns of the Heavenly Perfection, the Perfected Men of Wondrous Deeds, the Great Emperor of Fusang, the Imperial Lord of Green Radiance, the Wood Emperor of the Precious Splendor of Green Yang, and the Lord of the Nine Energies of the Upper Perfection arrived. They were accompanied by an innumerable host of heavenly officials, mounted cavalry, and perfected immortals, descending through the void. The precious clouds were thick and high, blending with the fragrance of incense and the tinkling of jade. They arrived in blue-gem carriages and the flying palanquins of the Eight Perfected, shaded by flowing canopies.

The Numinous Treasure scattered through the void; the seven colors of the celestial firewood glowed in the high sky. For nine days and nine nights, the sun, moon, and stars of the various heavens stayed their chariots and halted their wheels. The five planets converged their light, the heavenly scriptures followed their proper course, and the cosmic net was settled in stillness. The three paths were clear and peaceful, the flowing brilliance reached the celestial pivots, and the seven stars of the Dipper shone brightly. Throughout the land, the mountains, rivers, and forests became level and uniform; there was no longer high or low ground. The earth expanded, becoming like lustrous jade without any variation in color.

The Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning sat in the center of this gathering, floating in the profound void upon a jade pedestal of green unicorns, a seat made of sea-light and precious clouds. 

When he recited the scripture once, the Great Sages of the various heavens all praised the goodness. At that time, the evils of the men and women of the nation were eliminated, and they gathered to follow the True Way.

When he recited the scripture twice, a flowing crystalline light filled their bodies, making them complete and perfect. 

When he recited the scripture three times, the five internal organs bloomed with splendor, and the waters of the body were free from a hundred illnesses. 

When he recited the scripture four times, a golden light transformed their bones, and they were refined by the "Jade-Flourishing Form" <note>a state of celestial physical perfection</note>.

**The Way says:** These two chapters are the secret sounds of the High Emperors of the various heavens and the Most Spirit-like True Kings. These limitless writings provide universal salvation without end.

**The Way says:** When the cycles of Heaven and Earth reach their conclusion, the constellations move in error, the Sun and Moon lose their light, and the four seasons lose their order. The merit of fasting and reciting the scripture is extremely heavy. Above, it dispels heavenly disasters and protects the Emperors and Kings. Below, it repels poisonous harms to save the common people. Both the living and the dead receive blessings, and such blessings are difficult to surpass. Thus it is so.

## The Chapter on the Aerial Song of the Blue Empyrean

**The Way says:** In former times, within the Beginning Green Heaven <note>the first of the celestial realms in Daoist cosmology</note>, in the Land of Great Floating Slumber in the Blue Empyrean, I received the natural sounds of the Numinous Stanzas of the Void-Cavern of the Primordial Salvation of Mankind. From the Jade Terrace of the Blue Empyrean, celestial mists flowed and spread while divine winds drummed and stirred. Ten thousand sounds joined in harmony—rising and falling, clear and turbid, pitched high and low—winding and turning until they wove together into a song. Its sound penetrated the depths and echoed through all the heavens. At that time, even those among the ten thousand things of Heaven and Earth who were naturally silent were suddenly able to speak. They proclaimed the Way, established the teachings, opened the mystery, and founded the lineage. All living species understood the principles and clarified the laws.

The Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning <note>Yuanshi Tianzun, the highest deity and the source of these scriptures</note> then spoke this scripture. He circled through ten recitations to summon the worlds of the Blue Empyrean across the ten directions. Flying mists wove into threads, finer than a physical net. All the celestial beings, dragons, and divine birds stopped their carriages to come and go, as if there were no dark crevices left in the universe. The blue void shone with a dazzling brilliance, without limit or obstacle. The radiance flowed and cast shadows, one light penetrating ten thousand others. Within this, a divine wind arose, moving gently yet swiftly. Those who attained salvation through the singing of the song kept rhythm. The "Void Lute" and the "Sounds of the Law" pervaded everywhere. Boundless pearl towers and jeweled pavilions all emitted spiritual praises—praising the Way, praising the Law, and praising the Immortals. They exhorted the people of the various heavens to cultivate their ancestral lineage and perform good deeds, and to deeply awaken to the Supreme Way.

The Great Spirits of Heavenly Truth, the High Sovereigns and Exalted Elders, the Perfected Beings of Marvelous Conduct, and the natural "Aerial Song" of the Blue Empyrean's ultimate truth—along with an innumerable multitude of Golden Youths and Jade Maidens—came riding through the air. The deep purple void condensed into a still, cold, and clear blue clarity. The Kingly Horses <note>celestial steeds</note> were adorned with wheels of treasure and woven shadows. Celestial sounds and the "Hidden Language of the Great Brahma" <note>primordial creative sounds</note> arose in alternation. Nine-colored lights entwined and returned; the "Five Brightnesses" floated and shone. For seven days and seven nights, the inner perfected beings of the various heavens each ascended their Jasper Towers and struck the celestial drums. The Dragon-Void roared and the mechanisms of the stars connected. Within the twenty-four celestial treasure palaces, all became a blended blue color, like a vast, clear, undulating wave. The Seven Stars <note>the Big Dipper</note> shone like polished gems; the clouds looked like faces and the wind was silent. The desired scenery stretched out bright and clear. The lands, mountains, rivers, and forests of the entire country became fine, level, and uniform, with no more heights or depths. The celestial seas manifested their nourishment, and the soil and jade were lush and green. The "Cavern Song" resonated wildly, with no discordant colors.

The multitude of Perfected Beings attended the session. The Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning sat in mysterious meditation, floating in the void upon a throne of nine-emerald jade and ten thousand divine dragon pearls.

**As he spoke the scripture for the first time,** the aerial songs of the blue void and the chorus of sounds sang in approval. At this time, the men and women of the nation listened and whistled in joy; their hearts were opened, and there was no hidden place where the sound was not heard.

**As he spoke the scripture for the second time,** the flower-youths scattered radiance, reflecting and illuminating the infinite.

**As he spoke the scripture for the third time,** the Blue Empyrean formed into music. The divine wind played slowly, and the words were clear and transcendent.

**As he spoke the scripture for the fourth time,** Great Wisdom and the Broad Law spread, and all bodies became universally one.

**As he spoke the scripture for the fifth time,** those who heard the song awakened to the Law; they returned to the source and restored their life-destiny.

**As he spoke the scripture for the sixth time,** one's body and the surrounding environment appeared as clean as a real pearl. They manifested colors according to their direction, yet the emptiness of the Way remained unchanging.

**As he spoke the scripture for the seventh time,** they awakened to the fact that this "Aerial Song" originally has no beginning or end. The wind-sounds spread widely; the melody arose of its own accord. By entering the Way and ascending to the Truth, the principle is obtained from this.

**As he spoke the scripture for the eighth time,** they wandered through palaces and floated past gateways, bathing in the "Inner Sounds of the Blue Void." The clear song circulated, alternating between the hidden and the manifest.

**As he spoke the scripture for the ninth time,** the cavernous void gave birth to flowers, surging to form the ten realms. The men and women of the heavens entered and exited the "Yellow Chamber" <note>the center of the body or mind in meditation</note>, sinking into the blue and returning to the void, manifesting
<gloss>Earth 10</gloss>
the spiritual body of the Way.

**As he spoke the scripture for the tenth time,** mists spread across the ten directions. The song was completed in nine movements. Above, it reached the Great Brightness; below, it opened the dark night. The celestial beings held a great celebration, and the Numinous Treasure <note>Lingbao</note> manifested auspicious omens. At this time, every man and woman in the nation held the "Heavenly Threads" in their hands and trod upon the "Cloud Nets" with their feet. Their forms flew up to the High Purity <note>Shangqing heaven</note>, and all received protection and salvation, attaining long life.

# Wondrous Scripture of the Upper Chapters on Limitless Salvation of the Numinous Treasure, Volume 23

## Chapter on Descending the Truth and Summoning the Numinous

**The Dao says:** Formerly, in the **Palace of the Supreme Ultimate** <note>original: 太極宮</note>, amidst the violet glory of rising songs in the Land of the Great Penetration, the **Limitless Upper Chapters for Descending the Truth and Summoning the Numinous** were received. The **Celestial Worthy of the Primordial Beginning** <note>original: 元始天尊; the head of the Daoist trinity</note> was about to speak this scripture. He turned through ten cycles of recitation to summon the ten directions. 

When he first approached his seat, the Great Divine Beings of Celestial Truth, the High Sages and Lofty Sovereigns, and the Perfected Ones of Wondrous Conduct—an uncountable multitude—came riding through the air. Violet smoke rose to the empyrean, and feather-decked cloud-chariots with wide banners and misty canopies reflected the morning radiance. Five-colored embroidery blazed through the nine voids. For seven days and seven nights, the heavens and the earths, the Sun, Moon, stars, and constellations, the seas, mountains, and cavern palaces were all momentarily enclosed in a divine light. This numinous light shone through everything, and the atmosphere became clear and still. The lands, mountains, rivers, and forests of the entire nation became level and equal, without high or low. The earth was made of the **Seven Jewels** <note>symbolic precious materials like gold, silver, jasper, etc.</note>, possessing ten thousand wonders and flower-like colors. The various Perfected ones attended the seat.

The Celestial Worthy of the Primordial Beginning sat upon a mysterious throne floating in the void, a seat of divine gold that underwent ten thousand transformations. 

When he spoke the scripture **for the first time**, the Great Sages of Celestial Truth simultaneously praised the goodness. At that time, the men and women of the nation, regardless of status, were awakened to the Dao and virtue, and their true natures were opened. 

When he spoke the scripture **for the second time**, the divine transformations became manifest and bright. 

When he spoke the scripture **for the third time**, those with clouded consciousness reached the Mystery. 

When he spoke the scripture **for the fourth time**, the wondrous echoes from the empyrean cliffs became elegant melodies. 

When he spoke the scripture **for the fifth time**, the numinous scripts of the empty void shone brightly across the eight directions. 

When he spoke the scripture **for the sixth time**, the High Perfected and Upper Sages descended to teach humanity. 

When he spoke the scripture **for the seventh time**, the scriptural laws of the **Three Caverns** <note>original: 三洞; the three main divisions of the Daoist Canon</note> were universally proclaimed and practiced. 

When he spoke the scripture **for the eighth time**, the spirits of the dark and visible realms responded to thoughts and followed the heart; they felt the goodness and sent down auspiciousness, merging with virtue. 

When he spoke the scripture **for the ninth time**, demonic trials were eliminated and ceased.

# Wondrous Scripture of the Upper Chapters on Limitless Salvation of the Numinous Treasure, Volume 23 (Part 3)

The **Five Emperors** <note>The deities governing the five directions: North, South, East, West, and Center</note> elevate the immortals and speak the scripture ten times. The spirits bind the form, and the true breath is unified. At this time, every man and woman in the nation, without exception, turns their heart toward the teaching; all receive protection and salvation, and all attain long life.

**The Dao says:** At that time, the **Celestial Worthy of the Primordial Beginning** spoke the scripture for the **first time**. The Great Deity of the Primal Dao, along with an uncountable multitude from the Eastern Limitless and Infinite Rank, arrived floating through the void.

When he spoke the scripture for the **second time**, the Great Deity of Bright Truth, along with an uncountable multitude from the Southern Limitless and Infinite Rank, arrived floating through the void.

When he spoke the scripture for the **third time**, the Great Deity of Penetrating Truth, along with an uncountable multitude from the Western Limitless and Infinite Rank, arrived floating through the void.

When he spoke the scripture for the **fourth time**, the Great Deity of Still Restoration, along with an uncountable multitude from the Northern Limitless and Infinite Rank, arrived floating through the void.

When he spoke the scripture for the **fifth time**, the Great Deity of Ten Thousand Transformations, along with an uncountable multitude from the Northeastern Limitless and Infinite Rank, arrived floating through the void.

When he spoke the scripture for the **sixth time**, the Great Deity of Universal Radiance, along with an uncountable multitude from the Southeastern Limitless and Infinite Rank, arrived floating through the void.

When he spoke the scripture for the **seventh time**, the Great Deity of Flowery Truth, along with an uncountable multitude from the Southwestern Limitless and Infinite Rank, arrived floating through the void.

When he spoke the scripture for the **eighth time**, the Great Deity of Mysterious Emptiness, along with an uncountable multitude from the Northwestern Limitless and Infinite Rank, arrived floating through the void.

When he spoke the scripture for the **ninth time**, the Great Deity of the Violet Zenith, along with an uncountable multitude from the Upper Limitless and Infinite Rank, arrived floating through the void.

When he spoke the scripture for the **tenth time**, the Great Deity of the Penetrating Sovereign, along with an uncountable multitude from the Lower Limitless and Infinite Rank, arrived floating through the void.

When the ten recitations were completed, the Great Divine Beings of the Celestial Truth from the ten limitless directions arrived simultaneously. The men and women of the nation turned their hearts in devotion, coming like gathered clouds or flying mist. Because the uncountable multitude occupied half the nation, the earth began to tilt and sink under the weight, and it could not be stopped.

Thereupon, the **Primordial Beginning** transformed a **Precious Mountain** <note>original: 寶山</note>, shaped like the Min and Kunlun peaks. Within it were cavern chambers with four jade gates standing open. It hovered in the midst of the dark void, a thousand fathoms above the ground. The Primordial Beginning then led the Great Divine Beings of Celestial Truth, the High Sages and Lofty Sovereigns, the Perfected Ones of Wondrous Conduct, and the uncountable multitude of the Great Deities of the Ten Directions into the Precious Mountain. 

The people of the nation looked up and saw only a blurring mist entering through the jade gates. Once they had entered the jade gates, their location could no longer be known. The people of the nation then dispersed; the earth returned to being level and upright, no longer tilted or sunken. The Primordial Beginning finished speaking the entire scripture within the Precious Mountain. Through this teaching, the Perfected Sages recorded the numinous salvation. At that time, the joy was beyond words. When the ritual matters were fully concluded, the various heavens returned to their positions. In a sudden instant, all was silent, and no echoes remained.

At that time, the heavenly beings who had encountered the scriptural law all attained salvation. Fathers looked upon their children, and all enjoyed long years without illness or injury. The entire land turned in devotion, and all were awakened in their hearts. They were not heterodox, but sincere; not ignorant, but wise; not wild, but steady; they did not seek or lust; they did not harbor selfish thoughts. Their natures communicated with the Dao, and their bodies merged with the Ultimate Truth. Taking compassion and kindness as their foundation, their customs remained pure. The nation was secure, the people were prosperous, and they rejoiced in Great Peace. When the scripture first emerged, the whole nation followed the Dao; those who possessed a sincere heart and practiced worship all attained the ability to transcend the world.

**The Dao says:** The words spoken within the scripture by the Celestial Worthy of the Primordial Beginning are the inner names and esoteric rhythmic sounds of the Emperors within the <gloss>Triple Heavens</gloss> <note>original: 重三; likely referring to the three highest heavens of the Daoist cosmos</note> above the various heavens. They are also the hidden names of the Jade Caverns within the **Divine Zenith** <note>original: 神霄; the highest of the nine celestial realms</note>. They are not the common language of the world. 

The High Sages who have already become Perfected Ones can penetrate the mystery and investigate the subtle, fully understanding these chapters. If one recites them ten times, the various heavens will sing from afar, the ten thousand emperors will offer salutations, the rivers and seas will fall silent, and the Celestial Truth will attend the court. One can summon commands, and the divine spirits of the Three Heavens will halt their carriages. The celestial mechanism <note>the movement of the stars</note> will stop, and the thousand officials will stand in their ranks. This is the precious chart of the King of Kings, the hidden scroll of the Emperor of Grace. It can return the spirit to the corpse and raise the dead; it brings down the Truth and grants life. It turns white bones back into living people, and the practitioner gains the rank of a High Immortal.

If a scholar of the highest learning recites it ten times, the Five Emperors will descend to observe, the Three Officials <note>Deities of Heaven, Earth, and Water who judge merit and sin</note> will pardon transgressions, and the Earth Sentinels will cease their monitoring. Demonic trials will not invade, and those on the verge of death will be delivered and granted life. The reason for this is that the foul breath of the scholar has not yet been extinguished, and the body has not yet penetrated the Truth; thus, while they can control the majesty of the ten directions, they cannot yet control the heavenly administration. Their virtue can subdue the Earth Spirits and bind the demonic spirits, but it only wards off death and cannot yet grant rebirth to others. If one recites this chapter lightly or disrespectfully, calamity will befall their person. If one offers worship and respect, their household will flourish, their lineage will prosper through the generations, and they will be joined with good causes, remaining untouched by the ten thousand disasters as the divine beings protect their gates. This scripture is wondrous and supreme, standing alone in the Jade Capital. It saves limitless people and is the ancestor of the ten thousand Daos; its Great Brahma virtue is difficult to surpass.

**The Dao says:** Whenever this scripture is recited ten times, it brings down the Truth and summons the spirits. The various heavens arrive together, and the divine officials of the seas and prisons, along with the masters of Yin and Yang, all come to protect and deliver. Their petitions are presented to the High Heaven, and after nine years of such practice, the Dao is completed. They achieve long life, receive the Jade Script, and are listed among the ranks of the Emperor's ministers. When their merit is full and their virtue complete, there is nothing they cannot achieve, ascending to court at the Golden Gate and feasting in the Jade Capital.

When scholars of the upper path cultivate and recite this scripture, they bring down the Truth and summon the spirits, merging and transforming the hundred gods until they are one with the obscure and subtle, transcending and ascending in flight. Even if worldly people recite it without fully reaching the mysterious essentials, if their sincere thoughts are moved, they can still resonate with the Truth. They will have their lifespans extended, and the Wondrous Breath will nourish their physical forms, freeing them from illness and ensuring a long life. Later, they will all achieve the **Way of Corpse Liberation** <note>original: 尸解; a method of becoming an immortal where the practitioner appears to die but leaves behind a substitute object like a sword or staff while their spirit ascends</note>. Their souls and spirits will momentarily vanish, but they will not pass through the hells; they will immediately regain their forms and travel through the Great Void. This scripture is subtle and wondrous, universally saving without end. All celestial and human beings receive its blessings. Its limitless fortune bestows grace upon both the living and the dead. It is a treasure of the upper heavens, not to be transmitted to the lower world except through the most solemn rites and offerings of gold and jewels as a sign of efficacy.

**The Dao says:** During the long fast of the **first month**, if you recite this scripture, you will bring down the Highest Perfected of the Supreme Realm and summon the various spirits of the Three Realms. During the long fast of the **tenth month**, if you recite this scripture, you will bring down the Lower Perfected of the Supreme Realm and summon the various spirits of the Cavern Terrace. **Supreme Wondrous Scripture of the Primordial Beginning on Limitless Salvation**

Here dwell the Great Demon Kings of the Heavens <note>In this context, "Demon Kings" are powerful celestial guardians who test seekers and govern the unruly, rather than purely evil beings.</note> and the Numinous Spirits of the heavens. The extent of this limitless flourishing is so deep it cannot be calculated.

Our names are then recorded by the **True King of the Great Mystery**.

> The **Eastern Dipper** moves the celestial mechanism; the **Western Dipper** oversees the Qi; the **Northern Dipper** reaches the Dark Pole; the **Southern Dipper** gives birth to the spirit; and the **Middle Dipper** blends them all, supervising the multitude of spirits.

### The Five Emperors of the Directions
The divine transformations of the Five Emperors are proclaimed to gods and humans below:
*   **The Blue Emperor** bestows Benevolence.
*   **The White Emperor** clarifies Righteousness.
*   **The Red Emperor** oversees Propriety.
*   **The Black Emperor** generates Wisdom.
*   **The Yellow Emperor** presides over Trust.

> The Ten Thousand Spirits do not overstep their bounds. The **Blue Spirit Demon King** restrains the soul and fixes the floral radiance. The **Red Spirit Demon King** guards the spirit and establishes wisdom. The **White Spirit Demon King** stabilizes the lower soul and sweeps away impurities. The **Black Spirit Demon King** clarifies the perverse and settles the upright. The **Yellow Spirit Demon King** supervises the Ten Thousand Qi. These Five Spirits are the ancestors of all numinous beings. They fly in procession, followed by spirit-soldiers transformed from Qi, carrying dust-banners and holding ritual staffs as they wander through the Great Void.

---

> Their divine transformations are majestic, bringing the merit of longevity to the heavens. The heavens deliver people and strictly govern the **Northern Capital of Luofeng** <note>The Daoist purgatory.</note>. The Divine Kings receive their orders to sweep away all that is inauspicious. They gather the spirits and harvest the Qi, transforming into flying immortals. The "Golden Essence" exhales poison, and the "Heavenly Horses" gallop forth.

> Divine soldiers in four columns lead the way through drifting smoke. They charge in eight directions—who would dare resist the "Supreme Perfected"? The Golden Battle-axe strikes from the front; the Great Heaven punishes from the back. The ghosts and demons are slaughtered, and the wind and fire never stop. Thousands upon thousands, tens of thousands upon tens of thousands of demonic forms—all ghosts who dare to offend are crushed. The Three Offices of the Northern Capital strictly inspect the ghost camps; no concealment is permitted. The "Golden Horse" messenger delivers the report. A universal announcement is made to the infinite spirits: all must listen! The Five Emperors of the Three Realms report their words to the **Highest Clarity**.

### The Primordial Origin of the Universe
> The "Heavenly Origin" of the "Cavern Pole" gives birth and transforms without limit. Throughout the distant billions of kalpas within the chaos, there was no spirit above and no Qi below. Only the "Wind of the Marshes" filled the "Cavernous Void." At the limit of the void, it transformed into the Mystery. The Mystery gave birth to the Spirit. When the Spirit was pure, the Qi became "Perfected." This Perfected Qi then became the Spirit; the Spirit is the child, and the Qi is the mother. When Spirit and Qi merge into one, the "Ten Thousand Transformations" can be achieved.

> These transformations are the "Vajra" <note>original: "Jin-gang"; meaning "Diamond" or "Indestructible."</note> that rides upon the heavens. The "Hard Wind" <note>The powerful winds of the high heavens.</note> becomes the Qi; the movement of the wind becomes the Spirit; and movement gives birth to consciousness. The **Brahma-Qi** <note>original: "Fanqi"; primordial, pure celestial energy.</note> becomes the body, and through the transformation of Spirit and Qi, the Three Realms are naturally formed. The **Yang Spirit** becomes Heaven; the **Ying Qi** becomes the Springs (the underworld).

---

### The Internal Microcosm
> Heaven and Earth are limitless and formless, yet the Spirit descends and the Qi rises. The "Flowing Essence" enters the "Depressed House" <note>Metaphor for the womb or the internal organs.</note>. The primordial Great Brahma is vast and lightless. But when the "Red Brilliance" opens the map, the cycles of nature begin. The **Primordial Beginning** settles the universe and spreads the "Five Chapters." The "Jade Characters of the Red Script" and the "Dragon Script of the Eight Powers" protect the cycles of time, ensuring Spirit and Qi endure forever.

> Within the human body, the Spirit and Qi revolve. This transformation assists the ten thousand immortals. In the human body, the spirit is stationed in the **Niwan** <note>The "Mud Pill" palace in the brain.</note> and the **Crimson Palace** <note>The heart.</note>. When the Five Qi are harmonized within, the hundred spirits are blended. The Way of the Immortals prizes life; limitless is the salvation of people.

## The Second Chapter: The Mystery-Qi of the Dao Transforms the True Kings

The True Qi is within the Void; the True Qi is like the Void itself. I must distinguish it: it is identical to the Dao. When things obtain it, they live; when they abandon it, they are exhausted.

The Dao says: These are the Hidden Languages of the Great Brahma within the various heavens, the sounds of the limitless. # Supreme Wondrous Scripture of Numinous Treasure for Limitless Universal Deliverance, Volume 25 <gloss>Covering</gloss>

## Chapter on the Red Talisman and Cinnabar Light

---

The Dao says: In the past, within the **Heaven of the Final Firmament**, in the Land of Cinnabar Scenery, Pure Truth, and Great Mysterious Luminosity, I received the Limitless Supreme Scripture of the Red Talisman and Cinnabar Light of the Primordial Beginning for Universal Deliverance. 

When the **Celestial Worthy of the Primordial Beginning** <note>The highest deity in the Lingbao Daoist pantheon, representing the beginning of the universe.</note> was to speak this scripture, he revolved through ten recitations to summon the ten directions. Initially, as he took his seat, the Great Spirit-Gods of Heavenly Truth, the Red Spirit Script-Bearers, the Heavenly Lords of the Three Qis, and the Nine Immortals of Cinnabar Light—along with high honored ones, practitioners of wondrous deeds, and a boundless multitude of vehicles—came through the air. Jade-woven flying wheels and feathered canopies cast shadows; the Great Empyrean soared with crystalline light, as the Eight Essences radiated brilliance. The **Celestial Pivot** and the **Pearl Radiance** <note>Stars of the Big Dipper.</note> shone brilliantly, illuminating the Primordial Net. 

For five days and five nights, across the Three Pure Realms and the Four Domains <note>The highest heavens in Daoist cosmology.</note> and the boundless various heavens—reaching up to the **Daluo Heaven** <note>The highest, most inclusive heaven.</note> and down to the **Yellow Pass** <note>The subterranean realm of the dead.</note>—the "Red Mists of the Opening Kalpa" appeared. Precious talismans of flying empyrean and cinnabar clouds dispersed their light, reflecting upon the Eight Gates. Within the entire land, the mountains, rivers, forests, and trees were leveled and made equal; there was no longer high or low. Everything became like patterned jade, condensed in glowing brilliance, transparent and thorough without any differing colors. The multitude of Perfected Beings stood in a ring to attend.

The Celestial Worthy of the Primordial Beginning halted his carriage of floating kingfisher-green, atop the divine gold "Solar Mirror" wheels of the Nine Dragons, which undergo ten thousand transformations. 

**After speaking the scripture once,** the Great Sages of the various heavens simultaneously praised its excellence. 

**At that time,** the men and women of the land listened upward to the sacred proclamation; the heavy mysteries of their burning distress <gloss>Mystery Five</gloss> were cleared. 

**After speaking the scripture twice,** a heavenly light dawned from within, illuminating the dark and dim. 

**After speaking the scripture three times,** the spirit and qi merged and blended; the ten thousand sceneries generated spiritual fluids. 

**After speaking the scripture four times,** the void became bright, vast, and distant, allowing one to peer into the ten directions. 

**After speaking the scripture five times,** the Red Talisman and Cinnabar Light manifested within the body. 

**After speaking the scripture six times,** the Way of Life and the Dao converged; diseases and plagues were washed away. 

**After speaking the scripture seven times,** the dark domains of the Northern Feng <note>The Daoist hells.</note> saw their retributions and punishments cease. 

**After speaking the scripture eight times,** gold tablets recorded wondrous deeds and jade talismans fixed one's name in the registers; the Three Officials gave the command for the physical form to transform into a Flying Immortal. 

**After speaking the scripture nine times,** the Dharma-dew of forest blossoms moistened all things. 

**After speaking the scripture ten times,** the boundless dark passes of the ten directions and the Three Realms were opened; the limitless host of living beings wandered freely, separated from suffering. 

At this time, every man and woman in the land turned their hearts to receive protection and deliverance, and all attained long life.

The Dao says: When the Celestial Worthy of the Primordial Beginning spoke the scripture once, the Great Spirit of Precious Life of the Eastern Limitless and an immeasurable multitude arrived floating through the air. 
**When he spoke it twice,** <gloss>Two</gloss> the Great Spirit of Grotto-Floating of the Southern Limitless and an immeasurable multitude arrived floating through the air.
