As the ten recitations were completed, the Great Spirits of the Red Talisman and Cinnabar Light from the ten directions arrived all at once. The men and women of the land turned their hearts in refuge and looked up; they all saw great red characters filling the empty halls. The Cinnabar Light pierced through and illuminated the ten directions with equal brightness. Internally, they saw their own bodies; their hearts connected to ten thousand paths, and externally they merged with the Law. 

This is called the "Red Talisman": observing the myriad differences. 
This is called "Cinnabar Light": the True Body illuminating all. 

The paths of the internal and external are both from the Primordial Beginning. Externally, it gives birth to Heaven and Earth; internally, it transforms the individual body. All follow this Dao. Unless the ranked Sages open the teaching, transformation cannot be completed. For example, when Primordial Chaos was first created, it went through the Nine Kalpas of beginning and end; if not for the **Red Brilliance** <note>The name of a cosmic era.</note>, the diagram could not have been opened. When a single body is first born, the hair, limbs, and nine orifices are difficult to complete; if not for the "Spirit Light" appearing externally and the "Heart Light" connecting internally, the Sages and Worthies could not be perfected. Therefore, we all awaken to the Great Law spoken by the Primordial Beginning, employing divine transformations to lead both heavenly beings and humans. 

Those who came were like fine rain or dense mist; the immeasurable multitude made the land so heavy that half the earth sank down. This could not be stopped. Thereupon, the Primordial Beginning suspended a single **Precious Pearl**, as small as a grain of millet, in the midst of the empty mystery, five "zhang" <note>About 50 feet.</note> above the ground. The Primordial Beginning then led the Great Spirit-Gods of Heavenly Truth, the high honored ones, the practitioners of wondrous deeds, and the boundless multitude of Great Spirits of the Red Talisman and Cinnabar Light of the ten directions to all enter into the Precious Pearl. 

The heavenly beings looked up and saw only a surging crowd entering through the mouth of the pearl. Once they entered the mouth of the pearl, their location was unknown <gloss>Covering Three</gloss>. The people of the land dispersed, and the earth returned to being level and upright, no longer sloping or sunken. The Primordial Beginning then finished speaking the scripture within the Precious Pearl. The multitude of Perfected Beings oversaw the deliverance and then dispersed. At that time, the joy and celebration were beyond words. The ritual matters were roughly concluded, the various heavens returned to their positions, and in an instant, all was silent with no echoing sound left behind. At that time, the heavenly beings who had encountered this scripture and law were all delivered, completing their natural years without any premature harm. The entire land turned in refuge and all practiced the Dao.

## Volume 26: Chapter on Clarifying the Body and Permeating Qi

The Dao declares: Long ago, in the **Great Cinnabar Heaven** <note>Associated with the heart and the element of fire in Daoist internal cultivation</note>, amidst a world of crimson light where vermilion clouds condensed in the firmament, the **Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning** <note>The supreme deity representing the beginning of the universe</note> received the "Limitless Upper Chapters of the Primordial Beginning for Saving Humanity through Clarifying the Body and Permeating Qi." When the Celestial Worthy was about to speak this scripture, he declared:

"I am the Ancestor of Heaven and Earth, the precursor to the Myriad Qi. After the Three Treasure Heavenly Lords initiated transformation, the body of the Dao divided into three. Within the Great Void of chaotic yellow, clear vacuity, and cinnabar radiance, the Third Primordial Elder was born during the Great Eon. He is titled the **Most High Lord Lao** <note>The deified form of Laozi, representing the 'Dao' in active, teaching form</note>. He governs the Profound Qi and nurtures the people. This is my own Ultimate Dao manifesting as a spirit to transmit the teachings. Long ago, I already clarified this Dao. "I have already manifested the various heavens and revealed the essentials of the Dao. After these thoughts were formed, the Most High Lord Lao, residing in the Hall of Great Radiance within the **Palace of Great Clarity and Great Ultimate**, reverently heard these instructions. <gloss>Section 6 of Mystery</gloss> He questioned the seat of salvation, bowed his head twice, and knelt long and earnestly. He adjusted his robes and prepared to speak the scripture. Coral-beaded towers and the Imperial Flying Net across the deep vastness were clearly visible without obstruction.

The altar was purified, the chimes were struck, and the sound vibrated across the eight reaches of the universe. The **Most High Lord Lao** <note>The deified Laozi, speaking as the voice of the Dao</note> wore a faint smile upon his celestial countenance. He raised his "Five-Brilliance Jewel Fan" and leaned upon a golden, radiant table of red clouds. He addressed the assembly once more:

"The Dao emerges and becomes Spirit; Spirit transforms and becomes Qi. This Qi existed before Heaven, Earth, Yin, and Yang. It is the ancestor of the ten thousand transformations of the True Primordial—the subtle resonance of the Dao itself. This Qi has neither color nor shape; it is neither being nor non-being. It is not bound by Yin and Yang, nor does it belong to the Five Elements. It can generate, transform, complete, and solidify; it is the divine function of the Dao. Thus, it is harder than metal or stone, purer than ice or jade, greater than the Great Void, and older than the most ancient times."

"Internally, it congeals into Ultimate Essence to establish **Primordial Chaos** <note>Hundun: the state of the universe before form was distinguished</note>, and below, it reaches all living things. This Qi is the beginning. When it is called 'the enveloping and indistinct,' it means the Qi has manifested at the edge of form, and its substance is being molded within the **Great Simplicity** <note>Taisu: one of the stages of cosmic creation</note>. It acts as the subtle root of Heaven and Earth and is named the **One Qi**. Therefore, there are the True One, the Mysterious One, and the Supreme One—also called the three Qis of the Profound, the Original, and the Beginning. From the establishment of the **Jade Capital** <note>The highest celestial city</note> down to the gates of the underworld springs, all immortals, saints, spirits, humans, and creatures arise from this. All are born of the Dao without distinction of high or low, good or evil, strong or weak, firm or fragile. It is bestowed by Nature, without calculated action."

"It dissolves the Three Realms and perfects spiritual beings. It governs the honor of the sovereign and the humility of the minister, directs the labor of creation, and determines prosperity or ruin, wisdom or folly. As ranks are established, the Dao possesses the Most Holy Spirit, and Heaven possesses the Emperor who acts without partiality. The **Three Enclosures** <note>The three great regions of the night sky: Purple Forbidden, Supreme Palace, and Heavenly Market</note>, the stars and constellations, and the eight powerful divine officials carry out this administration. They record human merit and transgression, life and death. Not even a tiny grain or a mustard seed can escape their notice. Therefore, one must first clarify the 'body' to permeate it with 'Qi'."

"For instance:
*   The Dao is the **Body of Non-Being**.
*   Virtue is the **Embodied Body**.
*   Illumination is the **Body of Clarity**.
*   The Profound is the **Body of Darkness**.
*   Yang is the **Active Body**.
*   Yin is the **Still Body**.
*   Correctness is the **Immortal Body**.
*   Evil is the **Ghost Body**."

"Once the divisions of the body are determined, the corresponding Qi permeates it to grant life. If there is no body, it is permeated by

the Vast Qi. If there is an embodied body, it is permeated by the Primordial Qi. A body of clarity is permeated by Pure Qi; a body of darkness by Turbid Qi. When the clarified body permeates the **Flying Vessel** <note>Original: 飞甗 (Feiyan). Refers to a celestial vehicle or a vessel of spiritual transformation</note>, it illuminates the ten thousand transformations. Then the governance of the **Three Powers** <note>Heaven, Earth, and Humanity</note> is firmly established, and the work of merit is completed. One then transcends the Three Realms. The achievements of the High Perfected allow one to observe the records of good and evil and understand the principles of fortune and calamity. The multitudes of the ten directions—billions of humans, heavens, ghosts, and spirits—are transformed and set forth, leaving the cycle of reincarnation. The Way of the Immortals is attained, and one achieves long life in Non-Action, harmonizing with the Great Void."

The Most High Lord Lao finished speaking the scripture. The various Perfected Beings oversaw the transition and transmitted the teachings to me. At that moment, the joy was beyond words. The Way says: Within these various heavens are the Hidden Languages of the Great Brahma, the sounds of the Infinite. In ancient times, the original characters were ten feet wide. The Imperial Sovereign of Celestial Truth <note>Tianzhen Huangren: A high-ranking celestial being responsible for recording and guarding sacred texts</note> once traveled to the Bo-lin residence. Facing the dark mysteries of the five directions of Heaven, he led the manifest Emperors and Immortals in chanting to the Void. He captured these sounds through the "Fire Image" <note>An alchemical metaphor for refining the raw spiritual energy of sound into written form</note> and refined them for nine kalpas <note>An immense cycle of cosmic time</note> until the script was brilliant and fresh. 

They were written upon the royal screens of the Phoenix Pavilion of the Supreme Ultimate. A golden light naturally emerged from them, shining through all the heavens. A "True Disciple" who wears this text will ascend to immortality within twenty generations. Dragon carriages will arrive at their gate, and they will constantly serve before the Heavenly Emperor. If the cinnabar writing is burned and the ashes drunk with "Jasper Spring" water <note>Qiongquan: A poetic name for sacred water or alchemical saliva</note>, a hundred illnesses will leave the body, and one’s lifespan will equal that of the Nine Heavens. 

By writing this text, the Correct Tones are established. Those who know these sounds can transform and penetrate all things, leading to benefit and prosperity for the Way. If one fasts and recites them, the various heavens will dispatch Flying Sky Divine Kings to descend and observe the practitioner’s body. They will record the person's merit and diligently report it to the higher realms. The ten thousand gods of the heavens will pay homage, and the Earth Deities will stand guard at the gate. The Great Demon Kings will guarantee the practitioner's promotion to the rank of a "Higher Perfected." 

Once your cultivation in the Way is complete, you may travel through the Three Realms and enter the Golden Gate of Heaven. These sounds can ward off anything, exorcise any evil, save any soul, and transform any circumstance. The mortal body invites the numinous, and the vital Qi is guaranteed to ascend. These are the natural sounds of the Celestial Truth. Therefore, reciting them causes the Flying Sky spirits to look down, the High Emperor to sing from afar, and the myriad gods to bow. The Three Realms attend your chariot, the various demons bow their heads in submission, and ghostly spirits naturally perish. The numinous sounds of jade vibrate, the ten directions are purified, the rivers and seas fall silent, and the mountains and peaks are swallowed in awe.

# Vol. 27 of the Wondrous Scripture of the Upper Chapters of the Numinous Treasure on Infinite Universal Salvation <insert>Mysterious Seven</insert>

### The Chapter of the Purple Light and Cinnabar Numinous Spirit

The Way says: Long ago, within the Heaven of Great Cinnabar, amidst the Crimson Flower Numinous Spirit and the Great Mysterious Scenery Land, the "Universal Salvation of the Purple Light and Cinnabar Numinous Spirit" was received from the Primordial Beginning. As the Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning <note>Yuanshi Tianzun: The highest deity in the Daoist triad, representing the beginning of the universe</note> was about to speak this scripture, he circled the area ten times, addressing the ten directions. At that moment, the Great Spirits of the Heavenly Truths, the High Sages, the Perfected of Sublime Conduct, and the Great Spirits of the Primordial Transformation of the Purple Light and Cinnabar Spirit arrived in countless numbers. They came riding through the void on chariots of flying rosy clouds and carriages of tinkling jade, shaded by crimson clouds. Five-colored mists billowed and glowed through the Great Void. For seven days and seven nights, the spiritual gates of the various heavens, as well as the palaces of the Sun and Moon, emitted a congealed brilliance. The jade towers and layered cities became transparent and crystalline. The web of stars rotated, the five stars of the Northern Dipper radiated light, and the nine celestial paths scattered colorful patterns. <gloss>◌</gloss> Green mists intertwined as the "Precious Circle" <note>A symbolic representation of celestial perfection</note> floated through the scenery, and heavenly vapors pierced the sky. The lands, mountains, valleys, and forests of the country became perfectly level; no longer was there high or low ground. The earth itself turned purple and jade-like, without any variation in color. As the various Perfected Beings took their seats, the Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning sat suspended in the void upon a throne of nine-colored precious flowers and cinnabar-glowing flying jasper. 

When the scripture was recited **once**, the Great Sages of the various heavens simultaneously praised its goodness. At that time, the men and women of the country found their Dao-nature opened, and they fully realized the Dark Mystery. 

When the scripture was recited **twice**, the spiritual palaces overflowed with treasures, and the "Mysterious Spring" <note>A metaphor for spiritual energy or saliva in internal alchemy</note> surged with fluid. 

When the scripture was recited **three times**, the sublime patterns declared the subtleties, which spread densely through the entire body. 

When the scripture was recited **four times**, the "Twin Lights" <note>Usually referring to the Sun and Moon, or the internal eyes</note> paid homage to the Primordial, and the Jade Gates were joined in assembly. 

When the scripture was recited **five times**, the Cave Spirit responded to the changes, and birth and transformation occurred naturally.

# The Way of Eternal Life and the Three Luminaries

All the heavens revere these words together. To leak them or treat them with mockery will cause one to fall into the hells, and this calamity will reach back even to one's ancestors.

The Way says: These two chapters are the secret and hidden sounds of the High Sovereigns of the Various Heavens and the Celestial Perfected Ones of the Three Luminaries <note>the Sun, Moon, and Stars</note>. These are all "Great Brahma Words" <note>primordial, divine sounds of creation</note> and are not the common speech of the world. By inhaling their brilliance and drawing in their radiance, one can bring down celestial light, connect with the mystery, and transform into an immortal. Therefore, they are called "profound and obscure," and are difficult to investigate in detail. They are the treasures of the upper heavens, kept secret within the Eastern Treasury of the **Divine Empyrean Jade Palace** <note>Shenxiao Yufu: a high celestial administrative center</note>. According to the celestial statutes, they are transmitted to the lower world only once every 37,000 years to meet a turn of destiny. If there is a "Perfected Person" <note>an advanced spiritual seeker</note> who offers gold and treasures to prove their sincerity and follows the ancient rules, they may swear an oath to the Ten Heavens, after which these sounds may be bestowed upon them.

The Way says: The brilliance of the Three Luminaries is silent and never-failing. As the heavens circulate, how could there be a final end? When the Moon and Sun follow the same path, the Yin encroaches upon the Yang to hide its light; when the Sun and Moon follow the same path, the Yang covers the Yin to hide its splendor. The Qi rises and covers them, yet the Three Luminaries are never truly damaged. They are the ultimate essence of Heaven and Earth. If you can grasp their flowery brilliance, you will become a "Perfected One of the Highest Purity." You shall hold the tally of authority at the "Mysterious Terrace" and initiate the cycles of waning and waxing. When people experience misfortune or suffer from illness and injury, they should visualize the "Truth" and inhale the light, massaging the afflicted area. Or, they may meditate on holding the Sun and Moon in their hands and grasping the "Net of Stars." By doing so, one can spontaneously become a divine immortal and preserve life without aging. With a purified heart, perform the ritual of "Moving the Incense" ten times during the six periods of the day. Reciting the scripture will bring immediate blessings and eliminate all inauspicious omens. These are the texts of the Boundless One, offering universal salvation without end.

### Ritual for the Great Yin and the Five Dippers

When a fellow seeker is at the point of "Extinction and Passage" <note>death</note>, their companions should perform the incense ritual and recite the scripture ten times on their behalf. The Way says: The Three Luminaries are the ancestors of the High Way. The myriad images of reality rely on them for birth, and the immortals and saints achieve their status because of them. By looking up to their majestic divinity, one can subdue the demons of the Six Heavens. By drawing in their light to eliminate the darkness of the form, that light will penetrate the deepest shadows. It cleanses the "Womb of Life," prevents the scattering of the blood-essence, and resolves the enmities of seven generations. When the cycles of Heaven and Earth reach their end, the constellations may fall into disorder, the Sun and Moon may lose their brightness, the four seasons may lose their timing, disasters may strike the land, the "Qi of War" may appear, or plagues may spread. The merit of fasting and reciting is extremely heavy. Above, it dissolves celestial disasters and protects the Emperors; below, it repels poisonous harms and saves the people. Both the living and the dead rely on these blessings, which are difficult to surpass. Thus, it is called the "Boundless Universal Salvation of Devas and Humans."

All are recorded by the various heavens and guarded by the myriad gods. This distinguishes the "Perfected Person" who is destined to become a minister of the Golden Gate for the Saintly Sovereign. When the heavens record a person's deeds, they do not miss even a hair's breadth. The Demon Kings of the heavens will also protect your body. Those who attain the Way must use their power to clearly understand these ultimate words. Within the various heavens, the brilliance of the Three Luminaries is the "Boundless Sound of the Hidden Brahma Language."

# Volume 29 of the Numinous Treasure Scripture of the Most Exalted Infinite Universal Salvation Ends
## Section on Descending Truth and Extending Longevity

The Way says: Long ago, within the **Heaven of Primordial Azure** <note>the first and highest of the celestial realms in this cycle</note>, in the Vast Fuliyuto Land of the Jasper Void, the Primordial Beginning initiated the salvation of humanity. This is the ultimate chapter of the Way for "Descending Truth and Extending Longevity." As the **Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning** <note>Yuanshi Tianzun: the highest deity in the Daoist trinity</note> spoke this scripture, he circled the realm ten times, summoning the ten directions. At that moment, the Great Gods of Celestial Truth, the High Sovereigns and Exalted Elders, the Perfected Ones of Wondrous Conduct, the Spirit Kings of Merit and Virtue who descend truth and extend life, the Masters of Destiny who open transformation, the Lords of the Way who determine birth, and the Spirit Armies who protect the human soul—limitless multitudes of them—came riding through the void.

They controlled the stars in the Purple Clarity and soared through the winds of the Jasper Void. Vermilion carriages with tiered wheels and green-glinting axles advanced. Celestial canopies formed auspicious clouds, and the immortals played fragrant music. Divine light flashed in crimson colors, and the "Six Qi" <note>the cosmic energies of the seasons and elements</note> harmonized and gathered. The clouds of celebration filled the empty non-being. For seven days and seven nights, the Great Saints of the various heavens and the realms of High Truth materialized as palaces. The gates shone with rays of light, and the dharma drums flew in the four directions. The sounds of the immortals arose naturally, ringing like the bells on a carriage. The rhythms were clear and resonant. Winds blew through a thousand openings <gloss>the wind of the guest spirits</gloss>, swaying the Sun and Moon. Their brilliance ascended to join the stars, and the dual luminaries shone into the caverns. The Starry Consorts of the Nine Heavens grasped the celestial net with graceful ease. The Jade Emperor established the standard, gathering the Qi from the ten thousand directions, illuminating the Three Realms, and purifying the entire nation. The earth, mountains, and rivers became lush and moist; the cavernous seas rose in waves. Within each area of golden light stood a "Perfected Immortal" with a solemn expression and folded hands. Below them, the people looked up in anticipation, as if waiting for a promised time. The divine towers and majestic buildings towered high like dark peaks. Celestial flowers fell like rain, and embroidered silks spread out in circles. The multitude of Perfected Ones stood in attendance as the Celestial Worthy of Primordial Beginning sat upon the Throne of Ten Thousand Treasures in the Celestial Palace, atop a dragon soaring amidst pearls. As he spoke the scripture for the first time, the Celestial Truths of the ten directions responded by descending in their carriages, simultaneously gathering goodness for those in the world who study the Truth, so that their lifespans might be greatly extended. At that time, the men and women of the nation...

The Way says: Within these various heavens, the "Secret Words of the Great Brahma" <note>primordial, divine sounds of creation</note> are sounds of the infinite. They beckon the light of the Three Luminaries <note>Sun, Moon, and Stars</note> and draw in the "True Qi" of the Nine Heavens. When sung clearly at the gates of the celestial palaces, the Celestial Truths descend to meet the practitioner. These "Azure Characters" arise naturally; the Brahma-Qi is born within the palaces of the Three Luminaries to restrain the calamities of the Three Realms, whether great or small, and to prevent the disasters of water and fire. The Imperial Sovereigns of Celestial Truth carved these inscriptions upon the Sun, the Moon, and the constellations to exorcise hardships. They cut off blockages and stagnation and fixed the duration of one's destiny. For those who recognize this script, it serves to focus the spirit and command the "Six Ding" spirits <note>guardian deities of the Daoist calendar</note> to protect life and extend longevity, transmitting the spirit into the void. ### The Word of the Way: When the Cycles of Water and Fire Clash

When the two cycles of water and fire clash and the era comes to an end, the positions of the stars and the paths of the constellations will show deficits or surpluses. Even the highest Sage-Gods will go into hiding. Students of the lower path may fall ill. Whenever such disasters occur, all those of "shared-breath" <note>fellow practitioners or those of similar spiritual vibration</note> should employ this method of "Descending Truth to Extend Life." In the midst of sacred mountains or spiritual waters, beside great forests or eastern-flowing streams, or within the quiet halls of a fasting cloister, they should establish an altar. With incense, flowers, and ritual offerings, and by following the teachings, they should pray for the descent of the High Truths of the Three Realms, the sacred multitudes of the ten directions, and the armored cavalry of the Nine Heavens. These are the Great Gods who ward off calamity, eliminate disasters, and extend the "counts" of one's life <note>suan: a unit of life-span, often calculated as 100 days or 3 days depending on the context</note>. This should be performed for three, five, or seven days and nights. When the Celestial Truths descend, there will surely be a response: miraculous light, white cranes, or the extraordinary auspicious omen of heavenly music. Or, one might travel in dreams to the gates of Heaven and personally meet the Divine Beings. As these responses arrive daily, calamities will be averted, life will be lengthened, and one will attain the Way of Long Life. If one's worldly obligations are heavy and they lack the means to build such a grand altar, they should simply focus their hearts and practice the fast, offering incense during the six hours of the day. By reciting the scripture ten times, blessings and virtue will immediately descend to eliminate all that is inauspicious. This "Infinite Text" offers universal salvation without end.

### The Word of the Way: For Those Whose Dao-Learning is Shallow

If the person's worldly years were not meant to be exhausted, and the heaven-sent lifespan has not yet been fully extended, and yet prayers and efforts seem to fail and the majestic spirits do not arrive, one must immediately offer incense and recite the scripture ten times to deliver the "corpse-form" <gloss>14</gloss> <note>the physical remains</note>. If performed according to the law, the soul will travel directly to the Southern Palace <note>Nangong: the Daoist purgatory/refinery where souls are transformed into immortal essences</note>. ### The Word of the Way: Longevity as a Harmony Entrusted by Heaven

Longevity is originally a state of harmony entrusted by Heaven. At the beginning of birth, the Heavenly Officials calculate the lifespan to determine the "counts" of life. Secret "Yin-blessings" <note>merit earned through hidden good deeds</note> add to this count, while "Yang-offenses" <note>visible sins</note> subtract from it. The smallest unit of this ledger is a "count" of three days. A standard human life is set at one hundred and twenty years, while those of great merit may reach one thousand two hundred. The Heavens, Earth, Sun, Moon, and the four seasons of Yin and Yang all have their boundaries. If there are disasters or eclipses, performing the "Descending Truth" will extend the counts of life, ensuring protection as boundless as the heavens. If there are calamities of war, plagues, or if the common people are being harmed and teachers or practitioners are dying one after another, one must pray for the descent of the True Spirits. Beg for the extension of life, the refinement of the souls of the deceased, and the turning of disaster into blessing. The merit of the "Heavenly Fast" and the recitation of scripture is extremely heavy: above, it eliminates celestial disasters and protects the Emperor; below, it repels poisonous harms to save the masses. Both the living and the dead rely on this blessing. It is difficult to surpass, which is why it is called "Infinite Universal Salvation for the People of the World."

# Numinous Treasure Scripture of Infinite Universal Salvation, Volume 30 <gloss>Xiang</gloss>
## Chapter on Severing the Roots of Rebirth and Closing the Gates of Death

The Word of the Way: Formerly, in the Heaven of Initial Azure, within the Five-Brightness Flower Palace of the Purple-Pure Mysterious Grotto, I received the "Infinite Supreme Chapter on Severing the Roots of Rebirth and Closing the Gates of Death" from the Primordial Beginning. When the Primordial Beginning Heavenly Worthy <note>Yuanshi Tianzun: the highest deity in the Daoist trinity</note> was about to speak this scripture, he circled ten times to summon the ten directions. First, there arrived the Great Gods of the various celestial seats, the High Sages and Exalted Seniors, the Realized Persons of Wondrous Deeds, the Great High Spirit-King of Jade Purity who Vanquishes Demons, the Governor of Fusang, the Lord of Flowery Constancy, the Imperial Sovereign of the Golden Portal of the Later Sages, the Imperial Lords of the Ten Thousand Heavens, and the countless multitudes of the "Lamb-Yoke" <note>referring to a vast number of celestial attendants</note>. They came riding through the air on flying clouds of cinnabar mist, in green carriages with jasper wheels, shaded by feathered canopies. A flowing essence of jade-light in five colors burst forth in brilliance, illuminating the Great Void. For nine days and nine nights, the sun, moon, and stars of the various heavens, along with the rotating mechanism of the Jade Balance <gloss>70</gloss> <note>refers to the Big Dipper</note>, all stopped their rotations at once. The divine winds grew silent, the mountains and seas concealed their clouds, and the sky was without a single floating shadow. The four breaths were bright and clear. Throughout the entire country, the mountains, rivers, and forests became perfectly level, with no more high or low ground. All people awakened to the Way and attained the Law; the earth transformed into green jade without any differing colors. The multitude of Truths attended the seating. The Primordial Beginning Heavenly Worthy sat upon the Mysterious Emerald-Float, atop a throne made of solid "Glass-Pearl Spiritual Yang."

When he spoke the scripture for the **first time**, the Imperial Lords of the Ten Thousand Heavens simultaneously called out in praise and bowed their heads <gloss>51</gloss> twice, and all were able to perceive the Way. At that time, throughout the country, the men and women, the elderly and those yet to be born, all awakened to the Way.

When he spoke the scripture for the **second time**, the birds, beasts, and even the smallest insects all attained long life.

When he spoke the scripture for the **third time**, the four seasons became harmonious and peaceful, with no more extreme cold or heat.

When he spoke the scripture for the **fourth time**, the stars, sun, and moon, and the celestial multitudes all stood still and ceased their movement.

When he spoke the scripture for the **fifth time**, those with lingering illnesses and chronic ailments were all cured.

When he spoke the scripture for the **sixth time**, the earth became level and upright, and the autumn dust dissipated of its own accord.

When he spoke the scripture for the **seventh time**, the Five Elements became as one, harmonized by the completion of Heaven.

Return and circulate to the **Mud Pill** <note>Niwan; the upper elixir field located in the center of the brain</note>, passing through the gates of essence. Every portal opens, yet if they are not closed, one cannot achieve longevity. When the Dragon and Tiger <note>symbolizing Yin and Yang or lead and mercury in alchemy</note> stabilize the root, the blood congeals and the spirit gathers without dispersing; thus is perfection achieved. When dispersed, it is infinite and cannot be named. Rising and falling, one returns to the state of an "Infant" <note>a metaphor for the pure, primordial state of a realized immortal</note>. There is exiting and entering; there is death and life. The Way of severing [mortality] involves using fire to refine the essence, settling and guarding the portals. The womb congeals the root of the blood; the Yang bestows and the Yin transforms. # Wondrous Scripture of the Upper Chapters of the Limitless Salvation of the Numinous Treasure
**Volume 30**

The North Pole guards the spirit; the Golden Energy <note>associated with the West and ritual purity</note> enters the Three Realms. The Jade Marrow passes through the Nine Gates. The "Emperor One" <note>a high celestial deity residing within the body</note> blends with the Truth; there is neither manifestation nor light.

Within this Jade Script above the Three Realms, the "Song of the True King" harmonizes with the "Cavern Chapters." Recite it a hundred times, and your name will be recorded in the **Southern Palace** <note>the celestial office of life and immortality</note>. Recite it a thousand times, and the "Gates of Death" will be severed forever. After ten thousand recitations, blessings are complete, and one flies up into the Great Void, passing through the Three Realms to attain the rank of an Immortal Duke. This is heard by all. <gloss>eleven</gloss>

The Divine Sounds of the "Lady of Truth" and the "Primal Aunt" command the Earthly Deities; they stand guard and escort the practitioner. They pull the physical corpse out of the "Five Sufferings and Eight Hardships" <note>various states of karmic punishment and obstacles</note>. Seven generations of ancestors ascend to heaven, receiving duties in the Nine Palaces, and their souls are delivered to the **Crimson Hill** <note>Zhuling; the Southern Palace where souls are refined by fire</note>. <gloss>十二</gloss>

Refining the corpse for rebirth is what is called "Limitless and Infinite Salvation." These are the most secret writings of the upper heavens, revered by all the heavens together. To leak them or treat them with slow contempt leads to the hells, and the disaster reaches back even to one’s ancestors.

The Way says: These two chapters are the secret sounds of the High Sovereigns of the Heavens, the Spirit Kings, and the True King of Jade Purity. They are all words of the "Great Brahman" <note>Dafan; here referring to primordial, celestial language</note>. They are not the common phrases of the world; the words lack worldly rhyme and the melodies are without artificial flourish. Because they are subtle and profound, they are difficult to investigate in detail. They are the treasures of the upper heavens, kept secret in the wall-enclosed scripture chambers of the **Divine Zenith** <note>Shenxiao</note> and the Jade Purity Palace. These magnificent halls follow the "Dark Statutes." They are transmitted only once every sixty thousand eons. If there is a person of utmost virtue, they must offer gold and treasures as a pledge, their heart following the ancient standards. They must announce their oath to the Three Heavens, and only then may the text be granted to them.

The Way says: The cycles of Heaven and Earth have their ends; the Sun, Moon, and Five Stars have their waning and waxing. Even the Great Sages and Divine Beings have periods of rest or stagnation. Students of the latter days also suffer from illness and injury. Whenever there are such disasters affecting one's vital energy, it is because the physical form has already been recorded [for death]. One should pray for salvation by turning this scripture ten times. This shifts the spirit and stabilizes the energy, allowing one to attain rebirth. The "Limitless Text" universally saves without end.

---

The Way says: For those whose study of the Way is shallow, their immortal rank may not yet be filled, their "death-corpse" portals may not be closed, and the "roots of the womb" <note>mortal attachments</note> may still exist. When their cycle reaches the point of "Extinction and Deliverance" <note>death</note> and the body passes through the **Great Yin** <note>the underworld or the state of physical death</note>, fellow practitioners of the highest caliber should open the spirit and rescue them at the limit. They should gather the energy and transmit the Way to deliver the physical form. According to the law, the soul and spirit will go directly to the Southern Palace. Based on the merit of their studies, the days are counted until they achieve rebirth. Rotating through cycles without confusion, they then attain the status of a Divine Immortal.

The Way says: When the cycles of Heaven and Earth come to an end, one should perform the **Ritual of Purification** <note>Zhai; a communal ritual involving fasting and chanting</note>, circling with incense and reciting the scripture. When the stars <gloss>thirteen</gloss> move out of their proper degrees and the Sun and Moon lose their light, one should perform the Ritual of Purification, circling with incense and reciting the scripture. When the four seasons lose their order and Yin and Yang are out of harmony, one should perform the Ritual of Purification. When the ruler of the country faces disaster and weapons and armor arise on all sides <note>war</note>, one should perform the Ritual of Purification. When epidemics and toxins spread, and the common people suffer death and injury, one should perform the Ritual of Purification. When a fellow student passes away, one should also perform the Ritual of Purification. Indeed, the merit of observing the precepts and reciting the scripture is very heavy. Above, it dissolves celestial disasters and protects the Emperor; below, it repels poisonous harms to deliver the common people. Both the living and the dead rely on its blessings. These blessings are difficult to surpass; therefore, it is called the "Limitless Salvation of Heavens and Men."

The Way says: Wherever this scripture exists, it can act on behalf of the Heavens, the Earth, and the Sovereign. By performing this merit for the people, one severs the cycle of birth and death and transcends to the rank of an Immortal Official. On days of disaster, if one makes the resolve to perform the ritual, burning incense and reciting the scripture ten times, all the heavens will record their name, and ten thousand spirits will stand guard. Such a "Person of Utmost Virtue" is certain to become a minister of the **Jasper and Golden Gates**. The Heavens record people's merits and faults down to the smallest hair; nothing is lost. Even the Demon Kings of the Heavens will protect your body. Those who attain the Way should thoroughly understand these ultimate words.

# Central Chapter of the Numinous Book of the Primordial Beginning

## The Nine Heavens of the East

The Radiant Flower meets the Extraordinary; the Shining Demon is grand and bright. The Dark Essence disperses the subtle; the Crimson Blossom and Green [Energy] fly. The foul-smelling is subdued by the "Hum" of the Joyful; the vast territory is made suitable. The cave-fragrance is rich and thick; the returning defense floats lightly. The Spiritual Mark is brilliant and beautiful; the lushness is a celebratory clearing. Accepting the impure to make it pure; celebrations gather in the Liao-Void. Still moving toward that birth; covering the bends of ten thousand capitals. Taking part in the returning shadow-cloud; the forest of flags is submerged in smoke. The "Xun" record <note>referring to the Bagua/Trigrams</note> is entangled with the Horn [Star]; the Six Degrees are void and mysterious.

## The Nine Heavens of the South

Strictly gathered behind the curtain; the light-wielder is extravagant and wide. The Grand Fire swallows the clouds; the Brahman-energy of the Nine Doubts. Gathering the mechanism to mold [the world]; the Dragon passes the Red Flag. The branches are separated in the high clouds; the forest peaks are rare within. The celebration is subtle in the Cloud-Net; the Jade attachment transforms the corpse. Halting the ascent at the clearing; plucking the subtle to extend forever. The red wheel of grace is distant; covering the light and holding the circle. The vast mist respectfully connects; the embroidered falling of the bright mechanism. Determining the observation together with the [Lunar] Lodge; the Great Fluid floats in the Dawn. <gloss>fourteen</gloss>

## The Nine Heavens of the West

The fixed hope supports the essence; the Wan-ling valley is the foundation. Rubbing against the secular and the mundane moisture; fortunately bestowing the green separation. Pointing to the benefit of the echoing shadow; the elegant mist moves in unison. The empty wasteland is blunt and stammering; the dry bestowal of the benevolent script. Entrusting the falling to the mark; seeking the revival and extending the bestowal. Collapsing the green to distinguish the head; the power turns to return to the Truth.

### Chapter on Prolonging Life and Everlasting Vision

The Way says: Long ago, in the "Primordial Green Heaven," within the transformed land of the "Crimson Scenery and Jasper Brilliance," at the edge of the sky, there was a heaven called "Great Dark Joy." Purple clouds spiraled around it, and yellow mists smelled of fragrant flowers. The divine treasury, the mountain forests, the mist, the clouds, the wind, and the dew all took on the colors of clear rainbows and frequent mists. The immortal officials, divine attendants, assistants, and scribes were numbered by the hundreds of millions. Within this heaven, to the east, it connected to the Palace of East Mong and the Heaven of the Purple Pole, the Terrace of Bright Truth, and the Hall of Rare Jade. To the west, it joined the Palace of Assisted Zenith and the Heaven of Shining Scenery, the Terrace of Precious Spirits, and the Hall of Grand Harmony. These bound together to form eight seats, shining openly and brilliantly among the heavens. It was called the "Land of Ultimate Bliss."

The Celestial Worthy of the Primordial Beginning <note>Yuanshi Tianzun; the supreme Daoist deity</note> was about to speak this scripture to reveal the Great Law of "Prolonging Life and Everlasting Vision" <note>Changsheng Jiushi; a phrase from the Dao De Jing referring to the preservation of life and spirit</note>. The Primordial One, from his "Five-Colored Lion Throne" within the Primordial Green Heaven, looked toward the distant "Great Dark Joy Heaven." He was to teach the essentials of "Prolonging Life and Everlasting Vision," which allows one to transform from a common person into a Sage. The Great Imperial Lord of Long Life silently sensed the intent of the "Dark Dew" of the Primordial One. He then rose from his seat and commanded his left and right attending celestial officials, the supervisors of the scriptures, the incense officials, the jade boys and jade girls, and all the countless celestial people of his department... <gloss>seventy-one</gloss>

The Five Emperors of the realms are listed in the Higher Purity <note>Shangqing; the second highest realm of the Daoist heavens</note>. When the Great Mystery first divided, the Five Elders <note>The personified primordial energies of the five directions/elements</note> commanded the spirits. The Three Primordials transformed, creating the True Body. From the mouth, purple qi is exhaled, wrapping around the celestial root. This transforms into the Five Talismans, giving shape to all existing things. These talismans are the roots of heaven; suddenly, they transform into the truth.

The Jade Emperor dwells within his chamber, where the Three Luminaries <note>the sun, moon, and stars</note> revolve in brilliance. Within the "Cavern Chamber" of the six directions, one enters the mystery and emerges through the azure. There is green jade fat and yellow-red nectar condensing there. The Vermilion City and Golden Terrace rise in ten thousand folds, and the Jade Peaks stand in a thousand layers. Below, the muddy waves of the chaotic sea boil. The True Coverlet of the nine-headed dragon and the fire-clad clouds rush forth. The Black Stubborn One <note>a guardian deity</note> protects the world and its people; carrying them through the flickering flames is the true form of the Dao. 

The gale is as hard as stone, and the accumulated Yang energy forms the heavens. Above and below the heavens, there is no place too dark or obscure; there is no form, no shadow, no limit, and no end. Within the vastness of the Great Brahma <note>the primordial sound/breath of creation</note>, the "Red Brightness" <note>an era-name for a cosmic cycle</note> rises in the East. The Primordial Beginning nurtures the infant. Reaching the Southwest, there is the Crimson Court of Vermilion Light. Within it resides the Great Emperor, titled the Lord of Long Life. He was born alongside Heaven and shares the same brilliance as Heaven. 

Wearing phoenix-patterned robes and a plain skirt with a scarf of azure mist, he sits upright in the Cavern Palace, preserving the eternal existence of the practitioner. The returning light dwells forever, its energy connected to the Jade Capital. The Northern Dipper covers the self, while the Great One <note>Taiyi; the primordial unity</note> stores the essence. One's vision reaches the furthest depths of the dark and clear, beholding the five chapters of divine script. At the Turtle Terrace of the Spirit-Tiger, the primordial energy flows and spreads through the thirty-two <gloss>the first</gloss> heavens.

The wheels turn through the Realm of Formlessness, revolving through the ten directions. The wings of the stars pass through their degrees. The five <gloss>fourteen</gloss> constants and thirty-five divisions of total energy merge in the darkness of the Eight Brilliances of the Upper Primordial. Energy enters the Mystery of Mysteries <gloss>fifteen</gloss>. Within the Mystery, a register is bestowed, granting the practitioner long life. In a single blink, aeons pass; with "Everlasting Vision" <note>a Daoist term for spiritual longevity</note>, one lives for ten thousand years.

The Great Sovereign and Emperor of the Highest Truth floats upon the scenery and flows through the clouds, whistling and chanting the Cavern Scripture. Golden light ripples and revolves; the sound shakes the cloud-encampments. The circular radiance gathers energy, and the eight seas are clear to their depths. The Precious Abyss is lush and elegant; the Floating Capital is draped in banners. A thousand harmonies and ten thousand unions naturally form the Truth. 

Within, there are gods: the Great Lord of Long Life, the No-Hero Boy, the White-Prime Worshipful God, and the Great One, Master of Fate. They are joined by Tao Kang and He Yan <note>names of internal deities residing in the lower body</note>. Holding the talismans and grasping the registers, they protect life and give birth to its roots. They wander above in the Higher Purity, entering and exiting the Flowery Chamber. Within the eight stations of time and the most minute of spaces, they descend to stabilize the human body: in the "Mud Pill" <note>Niwan; the palace in the center of the brain</note>, the "Crimson Palace" <note>the heart</note>, and the center where the five energies are regulated. They blend the hundred spirits together. Through ten revolutions, the soul returns; ten thousand energies become equal to the immortals.

The Way of the Immortals values life; it saves people without limit. May I always be joined with life, treading the highest heights and the deepest darkness. Above, the Eight Gates are opened, and the Flying Celestial Dharma-Wheel turns. Whether through prohibitions regarding sin and blessing or through the causal conditions of past lives, all universally receive salvation. The Dao transforms the physical body, obtaining long life among the various heavens. Above the various heavens, each has a Gate of Life. Within them are the chapters of the "Empty Cavern" songs and the celestial texts of the various immortals, which are presented to the High Perfected Ones.

Above these Three Realms <note>The realms of Desire, Form, and Formlessness</note>, within the Heaven of Jade Brilliance, are the "Songs of the Flying Void" and the "Cavern Chapters of the Azure Tenuity." By reciting these one hundred times, one’s name is recorded in the Southern Palace <note>The celestial office where the records of immortality are maintained</note>. Reciting them ten times ensures the Heavenly Emperor himself will protect and welcome you. After ten thousand recitations, the Dao is perfected, and one ascends into the Great Void. Having passed beyond the Three Realms, one attains the rank of a Celestial Duke. When these numinous sounds are heard, the Immortal Kings show respect to one’s form, and the Earth Spirits stand guard. One is escorted by the "Flowing Fire" <note>a purifying celestial substance</note> which spontaneously ignites and enters the body. The body then glows like a pupil of light, illuminating the ten thousand gods. One achieves the status of a long-lived divine immortal; the "Embryo of the Dao" congeals into an infant, and "Dragon Qi" saturates the skin. You join the alliance of the Southern Pole and personally pay homage to the Yellow Elder <note>one of the primordial Five Elders</note>, receiving the divine script directly from his mouth. This is what is called "Limitless Universal Salvation." Those who wish to ascend to the heavens will be honored by all the celestial beings; however, those who are negligent or treat this with disrespect will fall into hell, and the disaster will reach back even to their seven generations of ancestors. <gloss>18</gloss>

The Dao says: These two chapters are the secret sounds of the Great Emperor of Long Life and the Divine Kings of Long Life. They are the "Speeches of the Great Brahma" <note>original: "Dafan zhi yan"; primordial sounds of creation that predate human language</note>, not the ordinary language of the world. They lack worldly rhyme or elegance because they are the Great Law for eternal existence and "Everlasting Vision." Because these chapters are hidden and secret, they are called "Dark Mysteries," and are difficult to investigate or understand in detail. They are treasured in the heavens and kept secret in the Upper Palace of the Purple Tenuity within the Dark Capital. According to the "Dark Statutes," they are transmitted only once every forty thousand aeons. If a person of the highest integrity offers gold and treasures and devotes their heart according to the ancient rules, swearing an oath to the Ten Heavens, only then may the text be granted to them. <gloss>the first</gloss>

The Dao says: The movements of Heaven and Earth have their endings; the sun, moon, and five stars have their waxings and wanings. Even the highest Holy Divine Men have their periods of rest or stagnation, and students of the later ages will suffer from sickness or injury. If you wish to extend your life and continue your destiny, or to pass safely through the turning cycles of time, you must pray and knock your head before the Great Emperor of Long Life and the Divine King of the Southern Pole. They will then command the "Note-Taking Kings" to examine your name and record it in the "Golden Registers," allowing you to escape the "Three Muddy Paths" <note>the three lower realms of rebirth: hell, hungry ghosts, and animals</note> and transcend the "Eight Difficulties" <note>eight conditions where it is difficult to hear the Dao</note>. Whenever such disasters occur, those of the same spirit should unify their hearts, practice the fasts, offer incense during the six periods of the day, and recite the scripture ten times. Blessings and virtue will immediately descend, and all unlucky omens will be dispelled. <gloss>11</gloss>

### The Limitless Text for Universal Salvation

The Dao says: For those who study the Great Law of Long Life and Everlasting Vision, their hearts must be in harmony with nature—dark, silent, and embracing the Dao—becoming one with the Great Creator. Their sincerity reaches the Jade Purity <note>the highest of the three Daoist heavens</note>, yet worldly wisdom often obscures them, and their physical shells prevent them from reaching the goal. Sometimes their destiny is to "change their bones" <note>a physical transformation into an immortal state</note> so their five viscera can be reborn. Sometimes their spirit dwells in the Nine Palaces <note>regions within the head</note> to refine its brilliance and achieve transformation. Or, if a student's knowledge is shallow and their immortal rank is not yet filled when they are destined to pass away, their body must go through the "Great Yin" <note>the underworld or the state of death</note>. Although they have followed the Law of Long Life, it was not yet complete, and their physical merit was lacking. If their heart was open and their spirit already achieved long life even though the flesh was not yet refined, then at the time of their passing, their fellow practitioners of the highest integrity should offer incense and recite the scripture ten times on their behalf to save their "living name." According to the Law, the Southern Palace will grant them the "Way of Life." Based on the merit they achieved as an "infant," the days will be counted, and they will obtain rebirth and rotation without confusion, immediately becoming a divine immortal. <gloss>20</gloss>

The Dao says: The Law of Long Life and Everlasting Vision is extremely restricted and of the utmost importance. One might maintain a heart of natural silence that accords with the Mysterious Way; or one might request the Law from a teacher to achieve long life; or one might labor in the world to accumulate various virtues that benefit all spirits, so that the Heavenly Palaces record one's name for eternal life. One might also achieve "Internal Vision" of the caverns, seeing through to the "Root of the Dao," looking down upon the two forces of Yin and Yang, and peering far back into past aeons. To such a person, the distant past is as close as this morning or last night, and the karmic debts of past lives are as clear as looking at a ruler in one's hand. They become companions of the Creator; life and death, appearing and disappearing, are within their own control. They can stretch a single day into an aeon or shorten an aeon into a day. For them, a thousand springs are but a morning, and ten thousand aeons are but a single night. Stretching or shrinking time is at their will. This is not something that can be achieved merely through study and recitation. Sometimes it is a special gift from heaven—an extraordinary temperament. Just as heaven has divine immortals, the earth has pines and cedars, and humanity has those of great age—these are all spiritual fulfillments that occur naturally. They hear the Dao and obtain it; they hear the Dao and are born from it, not relying on doctrine but possessing a separate, heavenly truth. <gloss>21</gloss>

***

For those who stand tall and prominent in the world: when the cycles of Heaven and Earth come to an end, when the three stars lose their order, when the four seasons are untuned, when disasters arise in the borders of the nation, when the "Aeon of Weapons" <note>war</note> never ceases, when diseases spread, or when a teacher or friend passes away—one should practice the fasts, offer incense, and recite the formulas of this scripture. The merit of the Great Fasts and the recitation of the scripture is heavy. Above, it dispels celestial disasters and protects the Emperor; below, it drives away poisonous harms to save the millions of people. Both the living and the dead rely on its blessings, which are difficult to surpass. Thus it is called "Limitless Universal Salvation for Heavens and Humans." <gloss>22</gloss>

The Dao says: Whoever possesses this scripture and can perform these meritorious deeds for the sake of Heaven, Earth, the Emperor, and the people—on the day of a disaster, if they set their heart on the fasts, burn incense, and recite the scripture ten times, the various heavens will record their names and ten thousand gods will stand guard. This "Perfected Person" will surely become a minister of the Holy Sovereign in the Golden Gate. The heavens record human merits and faults down to the smallest hair; nothing is lost. The True King of the Heavens will also recommend your body for promotion. Those who obtain the Dao should thoroughly understand these most important words. <gloss>23</gloss>

### Chapter on the Correct Energy of the Five Directions

The Dao says: Of old, within the **Heaven of Beginning Azure** <note>Shiqing Tian, the first of the three highest heavens</note>, atop the Grotto of Great Brilliance, stood the Palace of Substantial Flowing Spirit. There, the Gate of Non-Action and Great Compassion opened, widely birthing the profound mystery. In this realm of Void Purity, reaching up to the floating light, the Primal Transformation was a swirling chaos. Within the nine subtleties and eight gateways, spanning across the azure sky, were the essences of the vast stars and the brilliance of the sun and moon. Among them was a True King, titled **"Holder of the Moving Pivot"** <note>Han Yun Shu</note>. His Dao-power was natural, and his merit and rank were loftily mysterious. Within this realm was a divine mountain of wondrous treasures, extending deep into the heavens. There dwelt the Celestial Worthies of the Five Directions within palaces of purple mist and radiant light, served by millions of divine generals and billions of subjects. Their lifespans are infinite, and the atmosphere is like eternal spring, filled with the colors of ten thousand flowers which create a radiance that illuminates the seas. 

The Celestial Worthies are pulled by dragons of vermilion crests and green stripes, riding carriages of dark jade to serve the **Jade Emperor** <note>The supreme ruler of the heavens</note>. From this Correct Energy of the Five Directions, the essences of the Five Elements are produced. These follow the eternal path of Heaven and do not cause harmful conflict. This is called the **"One Original Energy of the Truth"** <term>Zhen Yi Yuan Qi: the singular, undifferentiated vitality of the universe</term>, the ancestor of the ten thousand things. It is the omen of all omens. Truly, it is not like the mundane energies of Yin and Yang which struggle against one another, creating cycles of birth and separation, growth and decay, or fleeting instability. 

The Great Compassion of the Primal Emperor transformed this True Realm. The Celestial Worthies of the Five Directions sat leisurely upon their jeweled thrones, breathing out the Correct Energy. They gathered, steamed, flowered, and rooted it; it flowed in waves, swift and far-reaching, establishing itself across the celestial boundaries. When Heaven attains this Correct Energy, its circular canopy does not tilt. When Earth attains this Correct Energy, the oceans and peaks are peaceful. When the Sovereign attains this Correct Energy, the movement of the Dao brings Great Peace. When humans attain this Correct Energy, they become the virtuous and the good of the world, admiring the Dao and seeking immortality, supporting the correct transformation of all things. Nothing remains untruthful. 

As the **Celestial Worthy of Primal Commencement** <note>Yuanshi Tianzun, the highest deity in this tradition</note> spoke this scripture, he completed ten rounds of recitation. First, he turned to the five directions and summoned the Celestial Worthies: 

*   To the East: **Celestial Worthy of the Nine Spirits of the Great Cavern’s Jade Truth.** 
*   To the South: **Celestial Worthy of the Three Glories of the Ultimate Cinnabar Light.**

In the Great Emptiness, one remains detached. Life and death coexist with the **Correct Energy** <note>original: "Zhengqi" – the vital, primordial breath that maintains cosmic and moral order</note>. The body can undergo billions of transformations. In stillness, the void is constant; in motion, it takes form. It responds universally to the ten directions, and the practitioner's path becomes equal to that of the various saints. Recognizing that the heart is like an illusion, one acts through **non-action** <note>original: "wuwei" – effortless action in alignment with the Dao</note>. When the Correct Energy enters the body, it merges with the process of transformation. One leaves behind the "congealed nets" of worldly entanglement, the "stomach-lining" <gloss>metaphor for internal blockages</gloss> is released, and the spirit-form flies into the Great Void to become the "Seed People of Heaven" <note>a Daoist term for the survivors of kalpa-cycles who populate the new world</note>. ### Chapter on the Divine Union of the Eight Luminaries
<note>The "Eight Luminaries" refer to the spiritual essences of the directions and the internal lights of the practitioner's body.</note>

The Dao says: Formerly, in the Heaven of Vermilion Yang <note>Zhuyang Tian</note>, within the land of Great Fusion and Prosperity, the "Limitless High Scripture of the Divine Union of the Eight Luminaries" was received from the Primordial Beginning. The Heavenly Worthy of Primordial Beginning <note>Yuanshi Tianzun</note> was about to speak this scripture. He revolved it ten times to summon the ten directions. First, he invited to their seats the Great Gods of the Celestial Truth, the High Sovereigns of the Upper Sages, the Realized Persons of Wondrous Conduct, and the limitless multitude of the Great Gods of the Three Primals and the Eight Luminaries. They arrived through the void, riding on divine clouds that spread flowers, in precious carriages adorned with jade and silk, under purple canopies that provided shade. The divine realm shone with a shared light; auspicious colors radiated and intertwined. The eight paths were brilliantly illuminated. For seven days and seven nights, the Eight Luminaries of the various heavens shone together naturally. A thousand gods and ten thousand spirits merged into a single primordial breath <note>Qi</note>, rotating together with the Primal Chaos. The land, mountains, rivers, and forests of the nation glowed with a fresh brilliance. All places, high and low, became a vast, level plain. The earth itself flickered with light, displaying a tapestry of vivid, shimmering colors. The multitude of Perfected beings attended the session. The Heavenly Worthy of Primordial Beginning sat in the void, suspended amidst the dense and venerable vapors upon the Pavilion of Jasper Radiance.

When he spoke the scripture **one time**, the Great Sages of the various heavens simultaneously praised its goodness. At that moment, the worldly desires of the men and women of the nation were permanently severed and removed.

When he spoke the scripture **two times**, they attained a thorough realization of the Ultimate Truth.

When he spoke the scripture **three times**, their consciousness merged with the profound Mystery.

When he spoke the scripture **four times**, they harmonized wondrously with the Primordial Breath, becoming one with its form.

When he spoke the scripture **five times**, their spirit condensed into a pure essence, protecting and stabilizing them while commanding the spirits.

When he spoke the scripture **six times**, the ten thousand gods blossomed within them, becoming equal and unified with their bodies.

When he spoke the scripture **七 times**, the Emperors of the Three Palaces <note>the upper, middle, and lower elixir fields of the body</note> assembled the divine perfected.

When he spoke the scripture **eight times**, the hundred joints of the body opened in harmony, the internal administrative offices <note>the "organ spirits"</note> connected with one another, the Gate of Death was blocked, and the roots of rebirth <note>the cycle of reincarnation</note> were severed.

When he spoke the scripture **nine times**, the three divisions of the body became bright and clear, and the Eight Luminaries returned in unison.

When he spoke the scripture **ten times**, the spirit and divine illumination merged completely; the body was transformed, and they became flying immortals.

At that time, every man and woman in the nation turned their hearts toward the teachings; all received protective blessings and attained long life.

The Dao says: At that time, when the Heavenly Worthy of Primordial Beginning spoke the scripture **one time**, the limitless multitude of the Great Gods of the Azure Luminary from the Eastern Limitless arrived, floating through the void.

When he spoke the scripture **eight times**, the limitless multitude of the Great Gods of the Obscure Luminary from the Northwestern Limitless arrived, floating through the void.

When he spoke the scripture **nine times**, the limitless multitude of the Great Gods of the Unified Luminary from the Limitless Above arrived, floating through the void.

When he spoke the scripture **ten times**, the limitless multitude of the Great Gods of the Transforming Luminary from the Limitless Below arrived, floating through the void.

When the ten cycles were complete, the Great Gods of the Eight Luminaries from the ten directions arrived simultaneously. The men and women of the nation turned their hearts in devotion, leaping for joy and saying: "Each of us, through our good deeds or by following the path of the Dao, has proven our blessed affinity and earned a place in this heaven."

By great fortune, they heard the Heavenly Worthy speak on this **Method of the Divine Union of the Eight Luminaries**, the path of supreme realization and ultimate transformation. At that moment, they approached the Heavenly Worthy to request the ultimate teaching. Like a fine rain or a dense mist, the countless multitude advanced until half the nation was following, an unstoppable tide of seekers. 

Then, the Heavenly Worthy of Primordial Beginning looked out across the ten directions. To clear the minds of the various classes of beings, he knitted his brow and waved his **Five-Brightness Feather Fan**. Slowly, he began to speak with a "jade voice" <note>a metaphor for the beautiful, resonant voice of a deity</note>, clarifying the essentials of the Law. He revealed how the single breath of the Supreme Ultimate <note>Taiji</note> divided and transformed, splitting into the Three Authorities and further partitioning into the **Eight Luminaries** <note>also translated as the "Eight Sights" or "Eight Brilliances"</note>. 

The Eight Luminaries are the spontaneous, natural spirits of the light and scenery of the eight directions. 

*   In **Heaven**, the Eight Luminaries have three divisions that correspond to the Three Primals <note>the celestial, terrestrial, and water realms</note>. 
*   In **Humans**, the Eight Luminaries have three divisions that correspond to the Three Openings. 

Therefore, the three divisions of the Eight Luminaries—the Twenty-Four Perfected Spirits—are the high spirits of the Supreme Path. By practicing this path, one causes the breath of the Eight Luminaries to merge with one's own spirit. When they harmonize, the hundred gods gather as one; when they disperse, they become a thousand perfections. One immediately becomes a High Immortal.

When the numinous power of the Eight Luminaries merges with the spirit in a state of Primal Chaos, one becomes a High Perfected Being. The Lord of the Way says: The movements of Heaven and Earth, and the waxing and waning of the Sun, Moon, and Five Planets, affect all. The Lord of the Way says: Those whose study of the Way is shallow, or those who are busy making a living and do not yet recognize the Truth of the Way, may fall victim to the essences of earth and stone, the monsters of grass and wood, mountain demons, forest ghosts, and various spirits of the air and water. The Lord of the Way says: When the cycles of Heaven and Earth reach their end, the constellations fall out of alignment, the sun and moon lose their brightness, and the four seasons lose their regularity.
